		private void cmdPaste_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (_isPastingObjectRows)
			{
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
				MmgExtensions.PasteObjectRows((MMViewModel)(object)this, text, "TRANSFER.EQ");
				return;
			}
			string asiFormatTextFromClipboard = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatTextFromClipboard))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				IList<string> list = ClipboardHelper.ParseCxsPathFromAsiFormat(asiFormatTextFromClipboard, ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, 1000000);
				((MMViewModel)this).PasteVariable((IEnumerable<string>)list);
			}
			catch (NullReferenceException)
			{
			}
		}

		private bool cmdPaste_CommandCanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (MmgExtensions.CanPasteObjectRows((MMViewModel)(object)this, "EQ"))
			{
				_isPastingObjectRows = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (((MMViewModel)this).CanPasteVariable())
			{
				_isPastingObjectRows = false;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool PasteVariable(IEnumerable<string> paths)
		{
			if (paths != null && paths.Count() > 0)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.EQVARTYPE", "value", (object)null);
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (string path in paths)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
					{
						SmgeExtensions.SMVariableAccessingParse((MMViewModel)(object)this, path, (VarAcessType)3, ref flag);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return ((MMViewModel)this).PasteVariable(paths);
		}

		private void Display2()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < cmdFind_Visibilities.Length; i++)
			{
				cmdFind_Visibilities[i] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"0");
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HybridVarVisible", (object)"0");
			for (int j = 0; j < initialVary.Length; j++)
			{
				int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + initialVary[j], "can_enter"));
				if (!num2.HasValue || num2.Value != 1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				_label_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				_label_captions[num] = initialText[j];
				object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + initialVary[j], "option_list");
				if (obj == null || obj.GetType() == typeof(DBNull))
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMTransfer_Input_From mMTransfer_Input_From)
				{
					object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMTransfer_Input_From).FindName("txtRows_" + num);
					MMTextEdit val = (MMTextEdit)((obj2 is MMTextEdit) ? obj2 : null);
					object obj3 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMTransfer_Input_From).FindName("cboRows_" + num);
					MMComboEdit val2 = (MMComboEdit)((obj3 is MMComboEdit) ? obj3 : null);
					if (initialText[j] == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
					}
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						if ((initialText[j] == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units || initialText[j] == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence) && !((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled)
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = true;
						}
						else
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = false;
						}
					}
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("row" + num, (object)initialVary[j]);
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("cboVarType_var1.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
				if (initialVary[j] == "EQVARIABLE" && Combo_Visibilities[num] == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					cmdFind_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					ComboWidth[num] = 154;
				}
				else if (initialVary[j] == "EQVARIABLE" && (text == "Block-Var" || text == "Sensor-Var"))
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.EQBLOCK", "value"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
					{
						text2 = ((MMViewModel)this).GetFullBlockName("@main", text2);
						if (((MMViewModel)this).GetModelCategoryByBlockName(text2) == 14 || text == "Sensor-Var")
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HybridVarVisible", (object)"1");
						}
						else
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"1");
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ComboWidth[num] = 182;
				}
				num++;
				if (num > 7)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int k = num; k <= 7; k++)
			{
				_label_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_combo_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_textEdit_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Captions");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Combo_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("TextEdit_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cmdFind_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("ComboWidth");
		}

		public string cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue
		{
			get

				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE.@array", "value"));
				_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = text;
				if (_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue != null)
				{
					foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item in MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE", "option_list"))))
					{
						if (item.UCase == _cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue)
						{
							_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = item.MCase;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return _cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue;
			}
			set
			{
				string text = _cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue;
				_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = value;
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
				if (!(_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue != text))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item in MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE", "option_list"))))
				{
					if (item.MCase == _cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue)
					{
						_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = item.UCase;
						break;
					}
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE.@array", "value", (object)_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue);
				Display2();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "optcopy_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				switch (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_COPY", "value")))
				{
				case "ENTSTRM":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("one", (object)"SET_STRM1");
					break;
				case "STRM":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("one", (object)"SET_FLOWS");
					break;
				case "SUBSTRM":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("one", (object)"SUB_SUB");
					break;
				}
			}
			if (pd.Name == "optCategory_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				object obj = optCategory_MultiMap;
				CxvMultiMapPropertyData val = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((obj is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? obj : null);
				if (val == null || val.Value == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				string optVal = val.Value.ToString();
				UpdateVarTypeOptions(optVal);
				Display2();
			}
			else if (pd.Name == "mbvnum_var1" && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				DoVarnameChange();
			}
			else if (subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				Display2();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private void cmdFind_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("array"));
			if (text.Length > 1 && int.TryParse(text.Substring(1), out var result))
			{
				result++;
				MmgExtensions.GxSearchVariable((MMViewModel)(object)this, ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main"), result, "", "", "VARY");
				Display2();
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
			}
		}

		private void cmdCopy_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			int item = 0;
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("array"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && text2.StartsWith("#"))
			{
				item = int.Parse(text2.Substring(1));
			}
			MmgExtensions.CopyObjectRows((MMViewModel)(object)this, text, "TRANSFER.VARY", (IEnumerable<int>)new Collection<int> { item });
		}

		private void cmdPaste_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (_isPastingObjectRows)
			{
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
				MmgExtensions.PasteObjectRows((MMViewModel)(object)this, text, "TRANSFER.VARY");
				string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE", "child_ids"));
				if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("array", (object)array[array.Length - 1]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				string asiFormatTextFromClipboard = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatTextFromClipboard))
				{
					try
					{
						IList<string> list = ClipboardHelper.ParseCxsPathFromAsiFormat(asiFormatTextFromClipboard, ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, 1000000);
						((MMViewModel)this).PasteVariable((IEnumerable<string>)list);
					}
					catch (NullReferenceException)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
		}

		private bool cmdPaste_CommandCanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (MmgExtensions.CanPasteObjectRows((MMViewModel)(object)this, "VARY"))
			{
				_isPastingObjectRows = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (((MMViewModel)this).CanPasteVariable())
			{
				_isPastingObjectRows = false;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool PasteVariable(IEnumerable<string> paths)
		{
			if (paths != null && paths.Count() > 0)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (string path in paths)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
					{
						SmgeExtensions.SMVariableAccessingParse((MMViewModel)(object)this, path, (VarAcessType)6, ref flag);
					}
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE", "child_ids"));
				if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("array", (object)array[array.Length - 1]);
				}
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
				return true;
			}
			return ((MMViewModel)this).PasteVariable(paths);
		}

		private void Display2()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < cmdFind_Visibilities.Length; i++)
			{
				cmdFind_Visibilities[i] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisibleTo", (object)"0");
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HybridVarVisibleTo", (object)"0");
			for (int j = 0; j < initialVary.Length; j++)
			{
				int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + initialVary[j] + ".@array", "can_enter"));
				if (!num2.HasValue || num2.Value != 1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				_label_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				_label_captions[num] = initialText[j];
				object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + initialVary[j] + ".@array", "option_list");
				if (obj == null || obj.GetType() == typeof(DBNull))
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMTransfer_Input_To mMTransfer_Input_To)
				{
					object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMTransfer_Input_To).FindName("txtRows_" + num);
					MMTextEdit val = (MMTextEdit)((obj2 is MMTextEdit) ? obj2 : null);
					object obj3 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMTransfer_Input_To).FindName("cboRows_" + num);
					MMComboEdit val2 = (MMComboEdit)((obj3 is MMComboEdit) ? obj3 : null);
					if (initialText[j] == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
					}
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						if ((initialText[j] == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units || initialText[j] == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence) && !((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled)
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = true;
						}
						else
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = false;
						}
					}
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("trow" + num, (object)initialVary[j]);
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("cboVarType_var1.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
				if (initialVary[j] == "VARYVARIABLE" && Combo_Visibilities[num] == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					cmdFind_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else if (initialVary[j] == "VARYVARIABLE" && (text == "Block-Var" || text == "Sensor-Var"))
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARYBLOCK.@array", "value"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
					{
						text2 = ((MMViewModel)this).GetFullBlockName("@main", text2);
						if (((MMViewModel)this).GetModelCategoryByBlockName(text2) == 14 || text == "Sensor-Var")
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HybridVarVisibleTo", (object)"1");
						}
						else
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisibleTo", (object)"1");
						}
					}
				}
				num++;
				if (num > 7)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int k = num; k <= 7; k++)
			{
				_label_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_combo_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_textEdit_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Captions");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Combo_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("TextEdit_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cmdFind_Visibilities");
		}

		}

		private void UpdateVarTypeOptions(string optVal)
		{
			ObjType objType = optVal switch
			{
				"ALL" => ObjType.otAll, 
				"BLOCK" => ObjType.otBlock, 
				"STREAM" => ObjType.otStream, 
				"MODUT" => ObjType.otUtility, 
				"PROP" => ObjType.otProperty, 
				"REACT" => ObjType.otReactions, 
				"SENSOR" => ObjType.otSensor, 
				"COST" => ObjType.otCosting, 
				_ => ObjType.otAll, 
			};
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list = MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE", "option_list")));
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (objType == ObjType.otAll)
			{
				if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
				{
					cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
				}
				if (cboVarTypevw_var2.SequenceEqual(list.Select((MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType p) => p.MCase)))
				{
					return;
				}
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
				{
					foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item in list)
					{
						cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item.MCase);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list2 = MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAGetVarIndex(list, objType);
			if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
			}
			if (!cboVarTypevw_var2.SequenceEqual(list2.Select((MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType p) => p.MCase)))
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item2 in list2)
				{
					cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item2.MCase);
				}
			}
			object obj = mbvnum_var1;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE." + val.SelectedItem, "value"));
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarFindUCaseIndex(list, text) == -1)
			{
				if (objType == ObjType.otSensor)
				{
					SetSensorVarType();
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item3 in list2)
			{
				if (text == item3.UCase)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ClearVarType();
		}

		private void DoVarnameChange()
		{
			object obj = mbvnum_var1;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				string selectedItem = val.SelectedItem;

		}

		protected override bool IsAllowedPasteTarget(System.Windows.DragEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = ((MMTabPagePastable)this).IsAllowedPasteTarget(e);
			if (!flag)
			{
				DependencyObject ancestorFromType = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, typeof(MMScrollArea), false);
				MMScrollArea val = (MMScrollArea)(object)((ancestorFromType is MMScrollArea) ? ancestorFromType : null);
				flag = val != null && (string.Equals(((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Name, "grdAll") || string.Equals(((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Name, "grdAll_Substm"));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private System.Windows.IDataObject CloneClipboardDataObject(IEnumerable<string> ignoreFormats = null)
		{
			try
			{
				System.Windows.DataObject dataObject = new System.Windows.DataObject();
				System.Windows.IDataObject oldDataObject = TimesExecution.TryExecute<System.Windows.IDataObject>((Func<System.Windows.IDataObject>)System.Windows.Clipboard.GetDataObject);
				if (oldDataObject != null)
				{
					string[] array = TimesExecution.TryExecute<string[]>((Func<string[]>)oldDataObject.GetFormats);
					if (array != null)
					{
						string[] array2 = array;
						foreach (string cf in array2)
						{
							if ((ignoreFormats == null || !ignoreFormats.Contains(cf)) && TimesExecution.TryExecute<bool>((Func<bool>)(() => oldDataObject.GetDataPresent(cf))))
							{
								object obj = TimesExecution.TryExecute<object>((Func<object>)(() => oldDataObject.GetData(cf)));
								if (obj != null)
								{
									dataObject.SetData(cf, obj);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return dataObject;
			}
			catch
			{
				return new System.Windows.DataObject();
			}
		}

	public static class DataHelper
	{
		public const string AsiFormat = "ASI Format";

		private const string InputSegmentInPath = ".Input.";

		private const string OutputSegmentInPath = ".Output.";

		private const string EOFlowsheetSegmentInPath = ".EO Flowsheet.";

		private const string SharedDataSegmentInPath = ".SharedData.";

		public const int CopyLimitCount = 100;

		public static readonly List<string> SpreadsheetRibbonPageNames = new List<string> { "RibbonPage_File", "RibbonPage_Home", "RibbonPage_Insert", "RibbonPage_PageLayout", "RibbonPage_Formulas", "RibbonPage_Data", "RibbonPage_View" };

		public static string GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard()
		{
			if (System.Windows.Clipboard.ContainsData("ASI Format"))
			{
				object obj = null;
				try
				{
					obj = System.Windows.Clipboard.GetData("ASI Format");
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				if (obj is string)
				{
					return obj as string;
				}
				if (obj is Stream)
				{
					using (StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(obj as Stream))
					{
						return streamReader.ReadToEnd();
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool ExecutePaste(string asiFormatText, MMViewModel viewModel, IList<ClipboardCellDataTuple> dataItems)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatText))
			{
				try
				{
					return PasteVariable(dataItems, viewModel);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<string> GetVariblesName(string asiFormatText, MMViewModel viewModel)
		{
			IEnumerable<string> pathsFromAsiFormat = GetPathsFromAsiFormat(asiFormatText, viewModel);
			foreach (string item in pathsFromAsiFormat)
			{
				yield return GetNodeVariableName(item);
			}
		}

		private static string GetNodeVariableName(string path)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				string objectIdSegment = GetObjectIdSegment(path, i);
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(objectIdSegment) || Guid.TryParse(objectIdSegment, out var _))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("_");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(objectIdSegment);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString().Replace("_", "");
		}

		private static string GetObjectIdSegment(string path, int offset)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = path.IndexOf(".Input.");
			int length = ".Input.".Length;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = path.IndexOf(".Output.");
				length = ".Output.".Length;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				string text = path.Substring(num + length);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					string[] array = text.Split('.');
					if (array.Length > offset)
					{
						return array[offset];
					}
				}
			}
			else if (offset == 0 && path.IndexOf(".EO Flowsheet.") > 0)
			{
				int num2 = path.LastIndexOf(".\"");
				if (num2 > 0 && path.Length > num2 + 2)
				{
					string text2 = path.Substring(num2 + 2);
					string text3 = string.Empty;
					if (text2.LastOrDefault() == '"')
					{
						text3 = text2.Substring(0, text2.Length - 1);
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						return null;
					}
					string text4 = string.Empty;
					num2 = path.LastIndexOf(".Variables");
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						string text5 = path.Substring(0, num2);
						text5 = text5.Replace("Top.appModel.EO Flowsheet.appModel.", "");
						if (text5.StartsWith("Blocks.") && text5 != "Blocks.")
						{
							text5 = text5.Substring(7);
						}
						text5 = text5.Replace(".Blocks", "");
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text5))
						{
							text4 = text5;
						}
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
					{
						text3 = text4 + "." + text3;
					}
					return text3;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool PasteVariable(IList<ClipboardCellDataTuple> dataItems, MMViewModel viewModel)
		{
			if (dataItems != null && dataItems.Count() > 0)

				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ClipboardCellDataTuple dataItem in dataItems)

			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string GenerateNewDefvarName(MMViewModel viewModel, string path, IList<string> oldIds, int initialNameLength)
		{
			int num = path.LastIndexOf('.');
			List<string> list = oldIds.ToList();
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = path.Substring(num + 1).ToUpper();
			if (text.Length > initialNameLength)
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, 5);
			}
			text = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && char.IsLetter(text.ElementAt(0))) ? GetValidNameDisplay(text, initialNameLength) : GetValidNameDisplay(path.Substring(0, num - 1), 4));
			string mapRegexName = GetMapRegexName(text);
			if (!list.Contains(mapRegexName))
			{
				oldIds.Add(mapRegexName);
				return mapRegexName;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
			{
				string text2 = $"{mapRegexName}{i}";
				if (!list.Contains(text2))
				{
					oldIds.Add(text2);
					return text2;
				}
			}
			oldIds.Add(text);
			return text;
		}

		private static string GetValidNameDisplay(string originalString, int length)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (int num = originalString.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (char.IsLetter(originalString.ElementAt(num)))
				{
					text = originalString.ElementAt(num) + text;
					length--;
				}
				if (length <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return text.ToUpper();
		}

		private static string GetMapRegexName(string originalName)
		{
			if (new Regex("[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]*").IsMatch(originalName))
			{
				return originalName;
			}
			int length = originalName.Length;
			int num = 6 - length;
			string text = string.Empty;
			char c = originalName.ElementAt(0);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				text += c;
			}
			return text + originalName;
		}

		internal static IList<ClipboardCellDataTuple> ParseDropDataFromAsiFormat(string asiFormatText, string textString)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatText))
			{
				try
				{
					IList<ClipboardTextDataTuple> dropTextDatas = GetDropTextDatas(textString);
					XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Parse(asiFormatText);
					if (xDocument != null && xDocument.Root.Element("FileMoniker") != null)
					{
						List<ClipboardCellDataTuple> list = new List<ClipboardCellDataTuple>();
						IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = xDocument.Root.XPathSelectElements("Items/Item");
						if (enumerable != null)
						{
							List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
							int num = 0;
							foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
							{
								string name = (string)item.Element("Name");
								string text = (string)item.Element("Path");
								int? rowIndex = (int?)item.Element("Row");
								int? columnIndex = (int?)item.Element("Col");
								if (!rowIndex.HasValue && !columnIndex.HasValue)
								{
									if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) && !list2.Contains(text))
									{
										ClipboardCellDataTuple clipboardCellDataTuple = new ClipboardCellDataTuple(name, text, num, 0);
										if (dropTextDatas.Count > num)
										{
											clipboardCellDataTuple.TextValue = dropTextDatas[num].Value;
										}
										list.Add(clipboardCellDataTuple);
										list2.Add(text);
									}
								}
								else
								{
									if (!rowIndex.HasValue)
									{
										rowIndex = 0;
									}
									if (!columnIndex.HasValue)
									{
										columnIndex = 0;
									}
									if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) && !list2.Contains(text))
									{
										ClipboardCellDataTuple clipboardCellDataTuple2 = new ClipboardCellDataTuple(name, text, rowIndex.Value, columnIndex.Value);
										ClipboardTextDataTuple clipboardTextDataTuple = dropTextDatas.FirstOrDefault((ClipboardTextDataTuple p) => p.RowIndex == rowIndex && p.ColumnIndex == columnIndex);
										if (clipboardTextDataTuple != null)
										{
											clipboardCellDataTuple2.TextValue = clipboardTextDataTuple.Value;
										}
										list.Add(clipboardCellDataTuple2);
										list2.Add(text);
									}
								}
								num++;
							}
						}
						return list;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static IList<ClipboardTextDataTuple> GetDropTextDatas(string textString)
		{
			List<ClipboardTextDataTuple> list = new List<ClipboardTextDataTuple>();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(textString))
			{
				return list;
			}
			string[] array = textString.Split(new string[2] { "\r\n", "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string[] array2 = array[i].Split('\t');
				for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
				{
					ClipboardTextDataTuple item = new ClipboardTextDataTuple(i, j, array2[j]);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static IList<ClipboardCellDataTuple> ParseCopyDataFromAsiFormat(string asiFormatText)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatText))
			{
				try
				{
					IList<ClipboardTextDataTuple> clipboardTextDatas = GetClipboardTextDatas();
					XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Parse(asiFormatText);
					if (xDocument != null && xDocument.Root.Element("FileMoniker") != null)
					{
						Dictionary<string, ClipboardCellDataTuple> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, ClipboardCellDataTuple>();
						IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = xDocument.Root.XPathSelectElements("Items/Item");
						if (enumerable != null)
						{
							new List<string>();
							foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
							{
								string name = (string)item.Element("Name");
								string text = (string)item.Element("Path");
								int? rowIndex = (int?)item.Element("Row");
								int? columnIndex = (int?)item.Element("Col");
								string text2 = (string)item.Element("Value");
								string text3 = (string)item.Element("ExposeAs");
								if (!rowIndex.HasValue)
								{
									rowIndex = 0;
								}
								if (!columnIndex.HasValue)
								{
									columnIndex = 0;
								}
								ClipboardTextDataTuple clipboardTextDataTuple = clipboardTextDatas.FirstOrDefault((ClipboardTextDataTuple p) => p.RowIndex == rowIndex && p.ColumnIndex == columnIndex);
								int? num = text?.LastIndexOf('.');
								if (num.HasValue && num > 0)
								{
									string text4 = text.Substring(num.Value + 1);
									if (text4.StartsWith("#") && int.TryParse(text4.Substring(1), out var result) && ((result < rowIndex.Value && clipboardTextDataTuple != null && (string.IsNullOrEmpty(clipboardTextDataTuple.Value) || clipboardTextDataTuple.Value == "\t")) || (result < rowIndex.Value && clipboardTextDataTuple == null)))
									{
										continue;
									}
								}
								if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(text))
								{
									ClipboardCellDataTuple clipboardCellDataTuple = new ClipboardCellDataTuple(name, text, rowIndex.Value, columnIndex.Value);
									if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
									{
										clipboardCellDataTuple.ExposeAs = text3;
									}
									if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
									{
										clipboardCellDataTuple.OriginalValue = text2;
										clipboardCellDataTuple.TextValue = text2;
										if (text2.Contains('\t'))
										{
											string[] array = text2.Split('\t');
											clipboardCellDataTuple.TextValue = array[0];
											string[] array2 = array;
											foreach (string text5 in array2)
											{
												if (double.TryParse(text5, out var _))
												{
													clipboardCellDataTuple.TextValue = text5;
													break;
												}
											}
										}
									}
									else if (clipboardTextDataTuple != null)
									{
										clipboardCellDataTuple.TextValue = clipboardTextDataTuple.Value;
									}
									dictionary.Add(text, clipboardCellDataTuple);
									continue;
								}
								string text6 = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2)) ? text2 : clipboardTextDataTuple?.Value);
								if (text6 != null && ((dictionary[text].ColumnIndex == 0 && columnIndex != 0 && double.TryParse(text6, out var _)) || dictionary[text].ExposeAs.Contains("Id") || !double.TryParse(dictionary[text].TextValue, out var _)))
								{
									ClipboardCellDataTuple clipboardCellDataTuple2 = new ClipboardCellDataTuple(name, text, rowIndex.Value, columnIndex.Value);
									if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
									{
										clipboardCellDataTuple2.ExposeAs = text3;
									}
									clipboardCellDataTuple2.TextValue = text6;
									dictionary[text] = clipboardCellDataTuple2;
								}
							}
						}
						return dictionary.Values.ToList();
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static IList<ClipboardTextDataTuple> GetClipboardTextDatas()
		{
			try
			{
				int maxRowIndex = 0;
				int num = 0;
				string asiFormatTextFromClipboard = GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard();
				XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Parse(asiFormatTextFromClipboard);
				List<ClipboardTextDataTuple> list = new List<ClipboardTextDataTuple>();
				if (xDocument == null)
				{
					return list;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				List<(int, string)> list2 = new List<(int, string)>();
				if (xDocument != null && xDocument.Root.Element("FileMoniker") != null)
				{
					new List<ClipboardCellDataTuple>();
					IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = xDocument.Root.XPathSelectElements("Items/Item");
					if (!enumerable.Any())
					{
						return list;
					}
					XElement xElement = enumerable.First().Element("Row");
					if (xElement != null)
					{
						num = (maxRowIndex = (int)xElement);
					}
					int num2 = maxRowIndex;
					foreach (XElement item2 in enumerable)
					{
						XElement xElement2 = item2.Element("Row");
						XElement xElement3 = item2.Element("Value");
						if (xElement2 == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int num3 = (int)xElement2;
						if (num2 < num3)
						{
							num2 = num3;
						}
						list2.Add((num3, xElement3?.Value));
						string text = item2.Element("Path")?.Value;
						int? num4 = text?.LastIndexOf('.');
						if (num4.HasValue && num4 > 0)
						{
							string text2 = text.Substring(num4.Value + 1);
							if (text2.StartsWith("#"))
							{
								if (int.TryParse(text2.Substring(1), out var result) && result < num3)
								{
									continue;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								flag = false;
							}
						}
						if (maxRowIndex < num3)
						{
							maxRowIndex = num3;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						maxRowIndex = num2;
					}
				}
				int maxRowIndex2 = GetMaxRowIndex("Items/Text");
				string[] array = System.Windows.Clipboard.GetText().Split(new string[2] { "\r\n", "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
				string value = array.LastOrDefault()?.Replace("\t", "");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && !list2.Where<(int, string)>(((int rowIndex, string cellValue) p) => p.rowIndex == maxRowIndex && p.cellValue != string.Empty).Any())
				{
					maxRowIndex--;
				}
				int num5 = array.Length - 1;
				if (array.Any() && string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					num5--;
				}
				int num6 = ((num5 >= maxRowIndex - num) ? (num5 - maxRowIndex + num) : 0);
				if (num6 > 0 && maxRowIndex2 > maxRowIndex)
				{
					num6 -= maxRowIndex2 - maxRowIndex;
				}
				if (num > 0 && HaveGridRowHeaderIndex(asiFormatTextFromClipboard, num))
				{
					bool flag2 = true;
					if (num6 != num && num6 > 1)
					{
						for (int num7 = 1; num7 < num6; num7++)
						{
							string[] array2 = array[num7].Split('\t');
							for (int num8 = 0; num8 < array2.Length; num8++)
							{
								if (double.TryParse(array2[num8], out var _))
								{
									flag2 = false;
									break;
								}
							}
							if (!flag2)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						num6 = num;
					}
				}
				for (int num9 = num6; num9 <= num5; num9++)
				{
					string[] array3 = array[num9].Split('\t');
					for (int num10 = 0; num10 < array3.Length; num10++)
					{
						ClipboardTextDataTuple item = new ClipboardTextDataTuple(num9 - num6 + num, num10, array3[num10]);
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
			catch
			{
				return new List<ClipboardTextDataTuple>();
			}
		}

		internal static bool HaveGridRowHeaderIndex(string asiFormatText, int firstAsiItemIndex)
		{
			XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Parse(asiFormatText);
			if (xDocument != null && xDocument.Root.Element("FileMoniker") != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = xDocument.Root.XPathSelectElements("Items/Text");
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				if (enumerable.Any())
				{
					foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
					{
						int? num = (int?)item.Element("Row");
						string value = item.Element("Value")?.Value;
						if (!num.HasValue)
						{
							return false;
						}
						int value2 = num.Value;
						if (value2 < firstAsiItemIndex && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && !list.Contains(value2))
						{
							list.Add(value2);
						}
					}
					if (list.Count == firstAsiItemIndex)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static int GetMaxRowIndex(string nodePath)
		{
			int num = 0;
			XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Parse(GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard());
			if (xDocument == null)
			{
				return num;
			}
			IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = xDocument.Root.XPathSelectElements(nodePath);
			if (enumerable.Any())
			{
				foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
				{
					XElement xElement = item.Element("Row");
					if (xElement == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (nodePath.Contains("Text"))
					{
						XElement xElement2 = item.Element("Value");
						if (xElement2 == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(xElement2.Value) || xElement2.Value == "\t")
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					if (int.TryParse(xElement.Value, out var result) && num < result)
					{
						num = result;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

	public class ClipboardCellDataTuple
	{
		public string Name { get; }

		public string Path { get; set; }

		public int RowIndex { get; }

		public int ColumnIndex { get; }

		public string DefinedId { get; set; } = string.Empty;

		public string TextValue { get; set; } = string.Empty;

		public string OriginalValue { get; set; } = string.Empty;

		public string ExposeAs { get; set; } = "Real";

		public ClipboardCellDataTuple(string name, string path, int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			Name = name;
			Path = path;
			RowIndex = rowIndex;
			ColumnIndex = columnIndex;
		}
	}
	internal class ClipboardTextDataTuple
	{
		public int RowIndex { get; set; }

		public int ColumnIndex { get; set; }

		public string Value { get; set; } = string.Empty;

		public ClipboardTextDataTuple(int rowIndex, int columnIndex, string value)
		{
			RowIndex = rowIndex;
			ColumnIndex = columnIndex;
			Value = value;
		}
	}

		private void SubscribeEvents()

			MMViewModel controlViewModel2 = ControlViewModel;
			if (controlViewModel2 != null)

		public void SaveSpreadsheetChanges()
		{
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				int num = default(int);
				int num2 = default(int);
				int num3 = default(int);
				ControlViewModel.GetSimulationStatusFlags(ref num, ref num2, ref num3);
				int num4 = ((!_ribbon.IsMinimized) ? 1 : 0);
				((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.RIBBON", "value", (object)num4);
				ControlViewModel.SetSimulationStatusFlags(num, num2, num3);
			}
			if (!spreadsheetControl1.Modified)
			{
				return;
			}

			{
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				spreadsheetControl1.SaveDocument((Stream)memoryStream, DocumentFormat.Xlsx);
				Workbook val = new Workbook();
				memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				if (val.LoadDocument((Stream)memoryStream, DocumentFormat.Xlsx))

		}

		private void OnCalculatorDefineVariableOperatedEvent(CalculatorDefineVariableOperatedEventArgs obj)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, (Action)delegate
			{
				//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0109: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_010f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_016f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0175: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				spreadsheetControl1.BeginUpdate();
				if (!((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPath("@main").Equals(obj.MainPath))
				{
					spreadsheetControl1.EndUpdate();
				}
				else
				{
					if ((int)obj.OperationType == 0)
					{
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(obj.OriginalName))
						{
							RenameVariableReference(obj.OriginalName, obj.NewName, obj.NewName);
							RenameVariableReference("L" + obj.OriginalName, "L" + obj.NewName, "L_" + obj.NewName, isVector: true);
						}
						else
						{
							DeleteVariableReference(obj.NewName, isVector: true);
						}
					}
					else if ((int)obj.OperationType == 1)
					{
						foreach (string deleteVariable in obj.DeleteVariables)
						{
							DeleteVariableReference(deleteVariable);
							DeleteVariableReference("L" + deleteVariable, isVector: true);
						}
					}
					else if ((int)obj.OperationType == 2)
					{
						RefreshSingleVariableCellStyle(obj.ModifyVariable);
					}
					RefreshVaribleComboxSource();
					UpdateLinkVaribaleCombboxSelectedValue();
					spreadsheetControl1.EndUpdate();
				}
			});
		}

		private void RenameVariableReference(string oldName, string newName, string linkVariableName, bool isVector = false)
		{
			DefinedName definedName = spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames.GetDefinedName(oldName);
			if (definedName != null && (!isVector || !definedName.Comment.Equals(oldName)))
			{
				Cell cell = definedName.Range[0];
				if (spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames.GetDefinedName(newName) == null)
				{
					LinkVariableToCell((CellRange)(object)cell, linkVariableName);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DeleteVariableReference(string deleteVariable, bool isVector = false)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(deleteVariable))
			{
				return;
			}
			DefinedName definedName = spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames.GetDefinedName(deleteVariable);
			if (definedName != null && (!isVector || !definedName.Comment.Equals(deleteVariable)))
			{
				if (definedName.Range != null && ((IEnumerable<Cell>)definedName.Range).Any())
				{
					ClearVariableCellFormat(definedName.Range);
				}
				spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames.Remove(deleteVariable);
			}
		}

		private void UnlinkItem_ItemClick(object sender, ItemClickEventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				Cell activeCell = spreadsheetControl1.ActiveCell;
				if (activeCell != null)
				{
					DefinedName definedName = ((CellRange)activeCell).GetDefinedName();
					if (definedName != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(definedName.Name))
					{
						spreadsheetControl1.BeginUpdate();
						spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames.Remove(definedName.Name);
						ClearVariableCellFormat(activeCell);
						SelectedLinkVaribale = string.Empty;
						spreadsheetControl1.EndUpdate();
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				spreadsheetControl1.EndUpdate();
				ShowWarningMsgBox(ex.Message);
			}
		}

		private void SingleItem_ItemClick(object sender, ItemClickEventArgs e)
		{
			string variableName = ((BarItem)((sender is BarButtonItem) ? sender : null)).Content.ToString();
			if (spreadsheetControl1.ActiveCell != null)
			{
				Cell cell = spreadsheetControl1.ActiveWorksheet.Rows[spreadsheetControl1.ActiveCell.RowIndex][spreadsheetControl1.ActiveCell.ColumnIndex];
				LinkVariableToCell((CellRange)(object)cell, variableName);
			}
		}

		private void LinkVariableToCell(CellRange cell, string variableName)
		{
			try
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(variableName) || cell == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				List<Comment> comments = cell.Worksheet.Comments.GetComments(cell);
				DefinedNameCollection definedNames = spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames;
				if (comments.Count == 1 && comments[0].Author == variableName)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (comments.Count == 1 && comments[0].Author != variableName)
				{
					DefinedName definedName = definedNames.GetDefinedName(comments[0].Author.Replace("_", ""));
					if (definedName != null)
					{
						RemoveNameReference(definedName);
					}
				}
				DefinedName definedName2 = cell.GetDefinedName();
				if (definedName2 != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(definedName2.Name))
				{
					RemoveNameReference(definedName2);
				}
				spreadsheetControl1.BeginUpdate();
				string text = variableName;
				if (variableName.Contains("L_"))
				{
					text = variableName.Replace("_", "");
				}
				DefinedName definedName3 = definedNames.GetDefinedName(text);
				if (definedName3 != null)
				{
					RemoveNameReference(definedName3);
				}
				string absoluteReference = GetAbsoluteReference(cell);
				if (!IsValidDefineName(text))
				{
					spreadsheetControl1.EndUpdate();
					ShowWarningMsgBox(string.Format(SpreadsheetControlResources.InValidDefinedNameWarning, text));
					return;
				}
				definedNames.Add(text, absoluteReference);
				DefinedName definedName4 = definedNames.GetDefinedName(text);
				definedName4.Comment = variableName;
				(string, VaribleInformationFlowEnum) varibleCommentDisplay = GetVaribleCommentDisplay(variableName);
				CreateCellCommentAndFormat(definedName4, varibleCommentDisplay);
				UpdateLinkVaribaleCombboxSelectedValue();
				spreadsheetControl1.EndUpdate();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ShowWarningMsgBox(ex.Message);
				spreadsheetControl1.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidDefineName(string variableName)
		{
			bool result = true;
			string strB = "LAA";
			if (variableName.Length <= 2)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < variableName.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!char.IsLetter(variableName[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			for (int j = 3; j < variableName.Length; j++)
			{
				if (char.IsLetter(variableName[j]))
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag && variableName.Substring(0, 3).CompareTo(strB) < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string GetAbsoluteReference(CellRange cell)
		{
			try
			{
				string[] array = ((object)cell.GetRangeWithAbsoluteReference()).ToString().Split(',');
				if (array.Length < 2)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				int num = array[0].IndexOf("\"") + 1;
				string text = array[0].Substring(num, array[0].Length - num - 1);
				int num2 = array[1].IndexOf("\"") + 1;
				string text2 = array[1].Substring(num2, array[1].Length - num2 - 1);
				return "'" + text2 + "'!" + text;
			}
			catch
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveNameReference(DefinedName existNameReference)
		{
			try
			{
				ClearVariableCellFormat(existNameReference.Range);
				spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames.Remove(existNameReference);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ShowWarningMsgBox(ex.Message);
			}
		}

		private void ClearVariableCellFormat(CellRange cellRange)
		{
			if (cellRange == null || !((IEnumerable<Cell>)cellRange).Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			((Formatting)cellRange[0]).Borders.RemoveBorders();
			if (spreadsheetControl1.SelectedComment != null)
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = cellRange.Worksheet;
				object obj;
				if (worksheet == null)
				{
					obj = null;
				}
				else
				{
					CommentCollection comments = worksheet.Comments;
					obj = ((comments != null) ? comments.GetComments(cellRange) : null);
				}
				List<Comment> list = (List<Comment>)obj;
				if (list != null && list.Contains(spreadsheetControl1.SelectedComment))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			RangeExtensions.ClearComments((CellRange)(object)cellRange[0]);
		}

		private void ClearVariableCellFormat(Cell cell)
		{
			((Formatting)cell).Borders.RemoveBorders();
			RangeExtensions.ClearComments((CellRange)(object)cell);
		}

		private (string comment, VaribleInformationFlowEnum infoFlowEnum) GetVaribleCommentDisplay(string variableName)
		{
			string variableName2 = variableName;
			bool flag = false;
			if (variableName.Contains("L_"))
			{
				variableName2 = variableName.Replace("L_", "");
				flag = true;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			string value = SpreadsheetControlResources.Comment_Variable + " : " + variableName.Replace("_", "") + "; ";
			stringBuilder.Append(value);
			VaribleInformationFlowEnum informationFlowType = GetInformationFlowType(variableName2);
			string informationFlowDisplay = GetInformationFlowDisplay(informationFlowType);
			string value2 = SpreadsheetControlResources.Comment_InformationFlow + " : " + informationFlowDisplay + "; ";
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(informationFlowDisplay))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value2);
			}
			string variableDefine = GetVariableDefine(variableName2);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(variableDefine))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(SpreadsheetControlResources.Comment_Definition + " : " + variableDefine);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return (comment: stringBuilder.ToString(), infoFlowEnum: VaribleInformationFlowEnum.VectorVariable);
			}
			return (comment: stringBuilder.ToString(), infoFlowEnum: informationFlowType);
		}

		private string GetVariableDefine(string variableName)
		{
			string result = "";
			string text = "";
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE." + variableName, "value"));
			if (text2 == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarTypes == null)
			{
				InitVaribaleTypesDefine();
			}
			foreach (MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType varType in MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarTypes)
			{
				if (text2 == varType.UCase)
				{
					text = varType.MCase;
					break;
				}
			}
			foreach (MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel.PromptType prompt in MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel.Prompts)
			{
				object obj = ((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + prompt.Variable + "." + variableName, "value", (string)null);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text3 = obj.ToString();
				string text4 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + prompt.Variable + "." + variableName, "can_enter", (string)null));
				if (text4 == null)
				{
					text4 = "0";
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) && (!prompt.HideWhenLocked || text4 == "1"))
				{
					if (prompt.ConvertToMixedCase)
					{
						text3 = MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel.StrConvMixCase(text3);
					}
					text = text + " " + prompt.Label + text3;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void InitVaribaleTypesDefine()
		{
			MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "option_list")));
		}

		private VaribleInformationFlowEnum GetInformationFlowType(string variableName)
		{
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.READ_VAR", "child_count"));
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.READ_VAR.#" + i, "value"));
					if (text != null && text == variableName)
					{
						return VaribleInformationFlowEnum.ImportVariable;
					}
				}
			}
			int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SCALE", "child_count"));
			if (num2.HasValue)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SCALE.#" + j, "id"));
					if (text2 != null && text2 == variableName)
					{
						return VaribleInformationFlowEnum.TearVariable;
					}
				}
			}
			int? num3 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.WRITE_VAR", "child_count"));
			if (num3.HasValue)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < num3; k++)
				{
					string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.WRITE_VAR.#" + k, "value"));
					if (text3 != null && text3 == variableName)
					{
						return VaribleInformationFlowEnum.ExportVariable;
					}
				}
			}
			return VaribleInformationFlowEnum.None;
		}

		private string GetInformationFlowDisplay(VaribleInformationFlowEnum infoFlowType)
		{
			return infoFlowType switch
			{
				VaribleInformationFlowEnum.ImportVariable => SpreadsheetControlResources.VaribleInformationFlowEnum_ImportVariable, 
				VaribleInformationFlowEnum.ExportVariable => SpreadsheetControlResources.VaribleInformationFlowEnum_ExportVariable, 
				VaribleInformationFlowEnum.TearVariable => SpreadsheetControlResources.VaribleInformationFlowEnum_TearVariable, 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private void SetVariableCellFormat(CellRange cell, VaribleInformationFlowEnum infoFlowType)
		{
			if (cell != null)
			{
				Color cellBorderColor = GetCellBorderColor(infoFlowType);
				((Formatting)cell).Borders.SetOutsideBorders(cellBorderColor, (BorderLineStyle)6);
			}
		}

		private Color GetCellBorderColor(VaribleInformationFlowEnum infoFlowType)
		{
			return infoFlowType switch
			{
				VaribleInformationFlowEnum.ExportVariable => Color.Blue, 
				VaribleInformationFlowEnum.ImportVariable => Color.Green, 
				VaribleInformationFlowEnum.TearVariable => Color.Red, 
				VaribleInformationFlowEnum.None => Color.Purple, 
				VaribleInformationFlowEnum.VectorVariable => Color.Gray, 
				_ => Color.Purple, 
			};
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			SaveSpreadsheetChanges();
			UnsubscribeEvents();
			SingleSpreadsheet.GetInstance().OpenedSpreadsheetHandleCollection.Remove(SpreasheetHandle);
			if (_ribbon != null)
			{
				_ribbon = null;
			}
			spreadsheetControl1.Dispose();
		}

		private object GetSpreadsheet(int spreadsheetHandle)
		{
			try
			{
				Type typeFromProgID = Type.GetTypeFromProgID(GetSpreadsheetCalculatorProgID());
				object obj = Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromProgID);
				return typeFromProgID.GetMethod("GetSpreadsheet").Invoke(obj, new object[1] { spreadsheetHandle });
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ShowWarningMsgBox(ex.Message);
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSpreasheetSource(int handle, Workbook wb)
		{
			try
			{
				Type typeFromProgID = Type.GetTypeFromProgID(GetSpreadsheetCalculatorProgID());
				object obj = Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromProgID);
				typeFromProgID.GetMethod("AddSpreadsheet").Invoke(obj, new object[2] { handle, wb });
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ShowWarningMsgBox(ex.Message);
			}
		}

		private string GetSpreadsheetCalculatorProgID()
		{
			return "AspenTech.AspenPlus.SpreadsheetCalculator" + _comProgIDSuffix;
		}

		private string GetComProgIdSuffix()
		{
			string result = default(string);
			ControlViewModel.GetComProgIDInfo(ref result);
			return result;
		}

		private async void LoadDocument(int spreadHandle)
		{
			try
			{
				object spreadsheet = GetSpreadsheet(spreadHandle);
				if (_isBeforeSaveExecutionFlag)
				{
					_isBeforeSaveExecutionFlag = false;
					return;
				}
				Workbook wb = (Workbook)((spreadsheet is Workbook) ? spreadsheet : null);
				if (wb != null)
				{
					if ((int)wb.Sheets.ActiveSheet.SheetType == 1)
					{
						spreadsheetControl1.CreateNewDocument();
						await Task.Delay(100);
					}
					spreadsheetControl1.LoadDocument(wb.SaveDocument(DocumentFormat.Xlsx));
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ShowWarningMsgBox(ex.Message);
			}
		}

				{
					return ((Collection<RibbonPageCategoryBase>)(object)_ribbon.SelfCategories)[i];

			}
			return null;

		private void SpreadsheetControl1_CellEndEdit(object sender, SpreadsheetCellValidatingEventArgs e)
		{
			_ = ((SpreadsheetCellEventArgsBase)e).Cell;

			{
				e.EditorText = "=" + e.EditorText;
			}
		}

		private void SpreadsheetControl1_ClipboardDataPasted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			string asiFormatTextFromClipboard = DataHelper.GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard();

			{
				IList<ClipboardCellDataTuple> list = DataHelper.ParseCopyDataFromAsiFormat(asiFormatTextFromClipboard);
				if (list != null && DataHelper.GetAsiItemsCount(asiFormatTextFromClipboard) <= 100 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatTextFromClipboard))
				{
					CopyVariable(asiFormatTextFromClipboard, list);
				}
			}
		}

				if (spreadsheetControl1.ActiveChartSheet == null)
				{
					spreadsheetControl1.ShowFormulaBar = true;
				}
				spreadsheetControl1.ShowStatusBar = true;
			}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (spreadsheetControl1.ActiveChartSheet != null)
				{
					SpreadsheetNameBoxControl childObject = VisualControlsSearch.GetChildObject<SpreadsheetNameBoxControl>((DependencyObject)(object)spreadsheetControl1, "PART_Combobox");
					if (childObject != null)
					{
						((UIElement)(object)childObject).IsEnabled = false;
					}
				}
				if (_ribbon == null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
					{
						_ribbon = VisualControlsSearch.GetChildObject<RibbonControl>((DependencyObject)(object)spreadsheetControl1, "PART_RibbonControl");
						if (_ribbon != null)
						{
							break;
						}
						Thread.Sleep(500);
					}

		private void SpreadsheetControl1_SelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			lock (_isInSelectionChanging)
			{
				Cell activeCell = spreadsheetControl1.ActiveCell;
				if (activeCell == null || spreadsheetControl1.Selection.RowCount > 1 || spreadsheetControl1.Selection.ColumnCount > 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				DefinedName definedName = ((CellRange)activeCell).GetDefinedName();
				if (definedName != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(definedName.Name))
				{
					List<Comment> comments = ((CellRange)activeCell).Worksheet.Comments.GetComments((CellRange)(object)activeCell);
					if (DefinedVariableCollection.Contains(definedName.Name) && comments.Any())
					{
						_isSelectionChange = true;
						SelectedLinkVaribale = definedName.Name;
					}
					else
					{
						SelectedLinkVaribale = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedLinkVaribale = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLinkVaribaleCombboxSelectedValue()
		{
			SpreadsheetControl obj = spreadsheetControl1;
			object obj2;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj2 = null;
			}
			else
			{
				Cell activeCell = obj.ActiveCell;
				obj2 = ((activeCell != null) ? ((CellRange)activeCell).GetDefinedName() : null);
			}
			DefinedName val = (DefinedName)obj2;
			if (val != null && !val.Name.Equals(SelectedLinkVaribale) && DefinedVariableCollection.Contains(val.Name))
			{
				_isSelectionChange = true;
				SelectedLinkVaribale = val.Name;
			}
		}

		private void SpreadsheetControl1_DocumentLoaded(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ControlViewModel != null)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{

					RefreshVariableCellsStyle();
					ResetWidthForHiddenColumns();
					spreadsheetControl1.Document.History.IsEnabled = true;
					_isBeforeSaveExecutionFlag = false;
					ResetDefineVaribaleRibbonGroupState();
				});
			}
		}

		private void ResetWidthForHiddenColumns()
		{
			foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)spreadsheetControl1.Document.Worksheets)
			{
				int rightColumnIndex = item.GetDataRange().RightColumnIndex;
				for (int i = 0; i <= rightColumnIndex; i++)
				{
					if (item.Columns[i].Width < 3.0)
					{
						item.Columns[i].Width = 3.0;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		{

		}

		private void RefreshCustomRibbon()
		{
			RefreshVaribleComboxSource();
		}

		private void RefreshVaribleComboxSource()
		{
			DefinedVariableCollection.Clear();
			SelectedLinkVaribale = string.Empty;
			Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "child_ids"));
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string item in collection)
			{
				DefinedVariableCollection.Add(item);
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE." + item, "value"));
				if (text != null && text.Contains("-VEC") && !collection.Contains("L" + item))
				{
					DefinedVariableCollection.Add("L" + item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefreshVariableCellsStyle()
		{
			try
			{
				Collection<string> collection = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "child_ids"));
				List<DefinedName> list = ((IEnumerable<DefinedName>)spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames)?.ToList();
				if (list == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (DefinedName item in list)
				{
					if (item.Range == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text = item.Name;
					string variableName = item.Name;
					Worksheet worksheet = item.Range.Worksheet;
					List<Comment> list2 = ((worksheet != null) ? worksheet.Comments.GetComments(item.Range) : null);
					if (collection != null && !collection.Contains(text))
					{
						text = item.Name.Substring(1);
						if (collection.Contains(text))
						{
							variableName = "L_" + text;
						}
					}
					if (collection != null && collection.Contains(text) && list2 != null && list2.Any())
					{
						bool visible = list2[0].Visible;
						(string, VaribleInformationFlowEnum) varibleCommentDisplay = GetVaribleCommentDisplay(variableName);
						CreateCellCommentAndFormat(item, varibleCommentDisplay, visible);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ShowWarningMsgBox(ex.Message);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshSingleVariableCellStyle(string variableName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(variableName))
			{
				return;
			}
			DefinedNameCollection definedNames = spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames;
			DefinedName val = ((definedNames != null) ? definedNames.GetDefinedName(variableName) : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Comment> comments = val.Range.Worksheet.Comments.GetComments(val.Range);
			if (comments != null && comments.Count >= 1)
			{
				(string, VaribleInformationFlowEnum) varibleCommentDisplay = GetVaribleCommentDisplay(variableName);
				comments[0].Text = varibleCommentDisplay.Item1;
				SetVariableCellFormat((CellRange)(object)val.Range[0], varibleCommentDisplay.Item2);
				DefinedNameCollection definedNames2 = spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames;
				DefinedName val2 = ((definedNames2 != null) ? definedNames2.GetDefinedName("L" + variableName) : null);
				if (val2 != null && val2.Comment.Equals("L_" + variableName))
				{
					val.Range.Worksheet.Comments.GetComments(val2.Range)[0].Text = GetVaribleCommentDisplay("L_" + variableName).comment;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateCellCommentAndFormat(DefinedName definedName, (string comment, VaribleInformationFlowEnum infoFlowEnum) flowInstance, bool commentVisible = false)
		{
			if (definedName.Range != null && definedName.Range[0] != null)
			{
				CellRange range = definedName.Range;
				RangeExtensions.ClearComments(range);
				Comment obj = range.Worksheet.Comments.Add(range, definedName.Name, flowInstance.comment);
				int length = flowInstance.comment.Length;
				((FloatingObject)obj).Height = 120f;
				((FloatingObject)obj).Width = length * 15 + 100;
				obj.Visible = commentVisible;
				SetVariableCellFormat(range, flowInstance.infoFlowEnum);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshVectorCellValue()
		{
			if (spreadsheetControl1 == null || spreadsheetControl1.Document == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				foreach (DefinedName item in (IEnumerable<DefinedName>)spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames)
				{
					if (item.Comment == null || !item.Comment.Contains("L_") || (item.Range != null && ((CellRange)item.Range[0]).Value != (CellValue)null))
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text = item.Comment.Replace("L_", "");
					DefinedName definedName = spreadsheetControl1.Document.DefinedNames.GetDefinedName(text);
					int num = 0;
					if (definedName != null)
					{
						Cell val = definedName.Range[0];
						if (val != null && ((CellRange)val).Value != (CellValue)null)
						{
							bool flag = true;
							int rowIndex = val.RowIndex;
							int columnIndex = val.ColumnIndex;
							while (flag)
							{
								if (((CellRange)spreadsheetControl1.ActiveWorksheet.Rows[rowIndex++][columnIndex]).Value != (CellValue)null)
								{
									num++;
								}
								else
								{
									flag = false;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (num > 0)
					{
						((CellRange)item.Range[0]).Value = CellValue.op_Implicit(num);
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void SpreadsheetControl1_Drop(object sender, System.Windows.DragEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_isDroping)
			{
				_isDroping = true;
				spreadsheetControl1.BeginUpdate();
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition((IInputElement)spreadsheetControl1);
				PointF pointF = new PointF((float)position.X, (float)position.Y);
				Cell cellFromPoint = spreadsheetControl1.GetCellFromPoint(pointF);
				if (cellFromPoint != null)
				{
					spreadsheetControl1.SelectedCell = (CellRange)(object)cellFromPoint;
					string text = e.Data.GetData("ASI Format")?.ToString();
					string textString = e.Data.GetData("Text")?.ToString();
					if (text != null)
					{
						GenerateAsiFormatVariable(text, DataHelper.ParseDropDataFromAsiFormat(text, textString), isDragVariable: true);
						RefreshCustomRibbon();
					}
				}
				spreadsheetControl1.EndUpdate();
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				_isDroping = false;
			}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
		}

		private void CopyVariable(string asiFormatText, IList<ClipboardCellDataTuple> dataItems)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatText))
				{
					GenerateAsiFormatVariable(asiFormatText, dataItems);
					RefreshCustomRibbon();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ShowWarningMsgBox(ex.Message);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAsiFormatVariable(string asiFormatText, IList<ClipboardCellDataTuple> dataItems, bool isDragVariable = false)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatText) || !dataItems.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<string> oldVaribaleNames = GetDefineVariables();
			if (oldVaribaleNames == null)
			{
				oldVaribaleNames = new List<string>();
			}
			if (!DataHelper.ExecutePaste(asiFormatText, ControlViewModel, dataItems))
			{
				return;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)ControlViewModel).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
			IEnumerable<string> defineVariables = GetDefineVariables();
			if (defineVariables == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> newAddVaribleNames = defineVariables.Where((string x) => !oldVaribaleNames.Any((string p) => x == p)).ToList();
			if (spreadsheetControl1.ActiveCell == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int rowIndex = spreadsheetControl1.ActiveCell.RowIndex;
			int columnIndex = spreadsheetControl1.ActiveCell.ColumnIndex;
			int clipboardTextItemLength = GetClipboardTextItemLength();
			int num = 0;
			(int, int, bool) clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment = GetClipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment(asiFormatText);
			if (clipboardTextItemLength > clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item1 && !isDragVariable)
			{
				num = clipboardTextItemLength - clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item1;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					int maxRowIndex = DataHelper.GetMaxRowIndex("Items/Item");
					int maxRowIndex2 = DataHelper.GetMaxRowIndex("Items/Text");
					if (maxRowIndex2 > maxRowIndex)
					{
						num -= maxRowIndex2 - maxRowIndex;
					}
				}
				if (dataItems.Any() && clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item2 >= 1 && !clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item3)
				{
					num -= clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item2;
				}
			}
			else if (clipboardTextItemLength == clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item1 && !isDragVariable)
			{
				num -= clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item2;
				if (num < 0 && DataHelper.HaveGridRowHeaderIndex(asiFormatText, clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item2))
				{
					num = 0;
				}
			}
			bool item = clipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment.Item3;
			bool flag = HaveRowOrColumnIndex(dataItems);
			if (!newAddVaribleNames.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<int, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, int>();
			int i;
			for (i = newAddVaribleNames.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
			{
				ClipboardCellDataTuple clipboardCellDataTuple = dataItems.FirstOrDefault((ClipboardCellDataTuple p) => p.DefinedId.Equals(newAddVaribleNames[i], StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase));
				if (clipboardCellDataTuple == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num2 = clipboardCellDataTuple.RowIndex;
				if (num != 0 && !item)
				{
					num2 = clipboardCellDataTuple.RowIndex + num;
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						num2 = clipboardCellDataTuple.RowIndex;
					}
				}
				else if (num > 0 && item)
				{
					num2 = num;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					num2 = i;
				}

		private (int rowCount, int minIndex, bool isHorizontalAlignment) GetClipboardDataRowCountAndAlignment(string asiFormatText)
		{
			bool item = false;
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = 0;
			IEnumerable<XElement> asiItems = DataHelper.GetAsiItems(asiFormatText);
			if (asiItems.Any())
			{
				foreach (XElement item2 in asiItems)
				{
					int? num3 = (int?)item2.Element("Row");
					if (num3.HasValue)
					{
						int value = num3.Value;
						if (num > value)
						{
							num = value;
						}
						if (num2 < value)
						{
							num2 = value;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num2 - num == 0)
				{
					item = true;
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				IEnumerable<XElement> textItems = DataHelper.GetTextItems(asiFormatText);
				if (HaveEndBlankRow(asiItems, textItems, num2))
				{
					return (rowCount: num2 - num, minIndex: num, isHorizontalAlignment: item);
				}
				return (rowCount: num2 - num + 1, minIndex: num, isHorizontalAlignment: item);
			}
			return (rowCount: 0, minIndex: 0, isHorizontalAlignment: item);
		}

		private bool HaveEndBlankRow(IEnumerable<XElement> dataItems, IEnumerable<XElement> textItems, int maxRowIndex)
		{
			try
			{
				if (dataItems == null || textItems == null || maxRowIndex == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsValidRowItem(dataItems, maxRowIndex))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsValidRowItem(textItems, maxRowIndex))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidRowItem(IEnumerable<XElement> items, int rowIndex)
		{
			foreach (XElement item in items)
			{
				if ((int?)item.Element("Row") == rowIndex)
				{
					string text = (string)item.Element("Value");
					if (text == null || text != string.Empty)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetClipboardTextItemLength()
		{
			try
			{
				XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Parse(DataHelper.GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard());
				if (xDocument != null && xDocument.Root.Element("FileMoniker") != null)
				{
					new List<ClipboardCellDataTuple>();
					IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = xDocument.Root.XPathSelectElements("Items/Item");
					if (enumerable.Any())
					{
						foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
						{
							string text = item.Element("Path")?.Value;
							int? num = text?.LastIndexOf('.');
							if (num.HasValue && num > 0 && !text.Substring(num.Value + 1).StartsWith("#"))
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				string text2 = System.Windows.Clipboard.GetText();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					int num2 = 0;
					string[] array = text2.Split(new string[2] { "\r\n", "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
					string value = array.LastOrDefault()?.Replace("\t", "");
					return (!array.Any() || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) ? array.Length : (array.Length - 1);
				}
				return 0;
			}
			catch
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private bool HaveRowOrColumnIndex(IList<ClipboardCellDataTuple> dataItems)
		{
			if (dataItems.Count <= 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ClipboardCellDataTuple clipboardCellDataTuple = dataItems.First();
			ClipboardCellDataTuple clipboardCellDataTuple2 = dataItems.Last();
			if (clipboardCellDataTuple.RowIndex == 0 && clipboardCellDataTuple.ColumnIndex == 0 && clipboardCellDataTuple2.RowIndex == 0 && clipboardCellDataTuple2.ColumnIndex == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			if (pd.Name == "advcboVentPro_ventprop" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				object obj = advcboVentPro_AdvCollection;
				CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (val.SelectedItem == Resources.MMPresRelief_Dynam2_VentPr_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Pressure)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("property", (object)"B_PRES3");
					}
					else if (val.SelectedItem == Resources.MMPresRelief_Dynam2_VentPr_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Temperature)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("property", (object)"B_TEMP3");
					}
					else if (val.SelectedItem == Resources.MMPresRelief_Dynam2_VentPr_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Vapor_fraction)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("property", (object)"B_VFRAC3");
					}
					else if (val.SelectedItem == Resources.MMPresRelief_Dynam2_VentPr_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mass_density)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("property", (object)"DENSITY");
					}
				}
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

			string text = ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate, "txtVarName_var1.Value") as string;
			if (!(list[num + 1] is grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate2))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text2 = ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate2, "txtVarName_var1.Value") as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				text2 = "#" + (num + 1);
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			int index = 0;
			int index2 = 0;
			int value = 0;
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			foreach (string item in CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "child_ids")))
			{
				if (item == text)
				{
					index = num2;
					value = num2;
				}
				if (item == text2)
				{
					index2 = num2;
				}
				list2.Add(num2);
				num2++;
			}
			list2[index] = list2[index2];
			list2[index2] = value;
			((MMViewModel)this).ReorderChildren("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", (IEnumerable<int>)list2);
			int num3 = list.Count - 1;
			if (num < num3)
			{
				num3 = num + 1;
			}
			SelectedRowIndexes = new ObservableCollection<int>(new int[1] { num3 });
			if (_cmdReorder_0_Command != null)
			{
				_cmdReorder_0_Command.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
			if (_cmdReorder_1_Command != null)
			{
				_cmdReorder_1_Command.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		private void cmdPaste_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			ExecutePaste();
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
			UpdateEditDetail();
		}

		public bool ExecutePaste()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (_isPastingObjectRows)
			{
				string[] oldIds = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "child_ids"));
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
				result = ((SelectedRowIndexes == null || SelectedRowIndexes.Count != 1) ? (MmgExtensions.PasteObjectRows((MMViewModel)(object)this, text, "DESIGNSPE.VARTYPE") != 0) : (MmgExtensions.PasteObjectRows((MMViewModel)(object)this, text, "DESIGNSPE.VARTYPE", SelectedRowIndexes[0]) != 0));
				UpdateSelectedRow(oldIds);
			}
			else
			{
				string asiFormatTextFromClipboard = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatTextFromClipboard) && ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider != null && ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case != null)
				{
					IList<string> list = ClipboardHelper.ParseCxsPathFromAsiFormat(asiFormatTextFromClipboard, ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, 1000000);
					result = ((MMViewModel)this).PasteVariable((IEnumerable<string>)list);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedRow(IEnumerable<string> oldIds)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = ((oldIds == null) ? array.FirstOrDefault() : array.Except(oldIds).FirstOrDefault());
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			SetSelectedVariableForMMEOBrowseEditor(text);
			object obj = grdDefine_GridData;
			CxvVectorPropertyData val = (CxvVectorPropertyData)((obj is CxvVectorPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < val.Count; i++)
			{
				if (val[i] is grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate && string.Equals(((CxvViewModel)grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE.@y", "id") as string, text))
				{
					SelectedRowIndexes = new ObservableCollection<int>(new int[1] { i });
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool cmdPaste_CommandCanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (MmgExtensions.CanPasteObjectRows((MMViewModel)(object)this, "FVN"))
			{
				_isPastingObjectRows = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (((MMViewModel)this).CanPasteVariable())
			{
				_isPastingObjectRows = false;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		private void UpdateEditDetail()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null || SelectedRowIndexes == null || SelectedRowIndexes.Count != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int index = SelectedRowIndexes[0];
			if ((grdDefine_GridData as IList)[index] is grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate)
			{
				string text = ((CxvViewModel)grdDefine_GridData_ItemTemplate).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE.@y", "id") as string;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					SetSelectedVariableForMMEOBrowseEditor(text);
					((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("VarTypePrompts");
				}
			}
		}
