					UCase = "WORK-POWER"
				});
				List<VarType> list = new List<VarType>();
				if (oplist != null && oplist.Count > 0)
				{
					string[] array = new string[oplist.Count];
					bool[] array2 = new bool[oplist.Count];
					for (int i = 0; i < oplist.Count; i++)
					{
						array[i] = oplist[i];
						array2[i] = false;
					}
					foreach (VarType varType in VarTypes)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
						{
							if (array[j] == varType.UCase)
							{
								list.Add(varType);
								array2[j] = true;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					for (int k = 0; k < array2.Length; k++)
					{
						if (!array2[k])
						{
							list.Add(new VarType
							{
								UCase = array[k],
								MCase = StrConvMixCase(array[k])
							});
						}
					}
					VarTypes = list;
				}
			}
			return VarTypes;
		}

		public static string StrConvMixCase(string InpVal)
		{
			string text = "";
			try
			{
				int result = 0;
				if (int.TryParse(InpVal, out result))
				{
					text = InpVal;
					return text;
				}
				string[] array = InpVal.Split('-');
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i].Length > 1)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + array[i].Substring(1).ToLower();
					}
					else if (array[i].Length > 0)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].ToUpper();
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length - 1; j++)
				{
					text = text + array[j] + "-";
				}
				text += array[array.Length - 1];
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return text;
		}

		{
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			string selectedItem = val.SelectedItem;
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < val.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (val.Items[i].Display == selectedItem)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			MmgExtensions.GxSearchVariable((MMViewModel)(object)this, ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main"), num + 1, selectedItem, "", "DEFINE");
			Display2();
			((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
			((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
			if (pd.Name == "optCategory_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				object obj = optCategory_MultiMap;
				CxvMultiMapPropertyData val = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((obj is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null && val.Value != null)
				{
					string optVal = val.Value.ToString();
					UpdateVarTypeOptions(optVal);
					Display2();
				}
			}
			else if (pd.Name == "mnuVarname_ListVar" && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				DoVarnameChange();
			}
			else if (subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				Display2();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVarTypeOptions(string optVal)
		{
			ObjType objType = optVal switch
			{
				"ALL" => ObjType.otAll, 
				"BLOCK" => ObjType.otBlock, 
				"STREAM" => ObjType.otStream, 
				"MODUT" => ObjType.otUtility, 
				"PROP" => ObjType.otProperty, 
				"REACT" => ObjType.otReactions, 
				"SENSOR" => ObjType.otSensor, 
				"COST" => ObjType.otCosting, 
				_ => ObjType.otAll, 
			};
			List<VarType> list = VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "option_list")));
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (objType == ObjType.otAll)
			{
				if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
				{
					cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
				}
				if (cboVarTypevw_var2.SequenceEqual(list.Select((VarType p) => p.MCase)))
				{
					return;
				}
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
				{
					foreach (VarType item in list)
					{
						cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item.MCase);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			List<VarType> list2 = VAGetVarIndex(list, objType);
			if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
			}
			if (!cboVarTypevw_var2.SequenceEqual(list2.Select((VarType p) => p.MCase)))
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
				foreach (VarType item2 in list2)
				{
					cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item2.MCase);
				}
			}
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE." + val.SelectedItem, "value"));
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (VAVarFindUCaseIndex(list, text) == -1)
			{
				if (objType == ObjType.otSensor)
				{
					SetSensorVarType();
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (VarType item3 in list2)
			{
				if (text == item3.UCase)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ClearVarType();
		}

		private void DoVarnameChange()
		{
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				string selectedItem = val.SelectedItem;
				string optVal = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_CATEG." + selectedItem, "value"));
				UpdateVarTypeOptions(optVal);
				SetSelectedVariableForMMEOBrowseEditor(selectedItem);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("xInt", (object)selectedItem);
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("VarTypePrompts");
			}
		}

		private void ClearVarType()
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE.@xInt", "value", (object)"");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
		}

		private void SetSensorVarType()
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE.@xInt", "value", (object)"SENSOR-VAR");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
		}

		private void Display2()
		{
			List<PromptType> list = VAPromptInit();
			byte b = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < cmdFind_Visibilities.Length; i++)
			{
				cmdFind_Visibilities[i] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"0", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HybridVarVisible", (object)"0", true);
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				PromptType promptType = list[j];
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + promptType.Variable + ".@xInt", "can_enter"));
				if (text == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + promptType.Variable + ".@xInt", "value"));
				if (text2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = !(text == "1");
				if (flag && (!(promptType.Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units) || !(text2 != "")))
				{
					continue;
				}
				_label_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Visible;
				_label_captions[b] = list[j].Text;
				object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + promptType.Variable + ".@xInt", "option_list");
				if (obj == null || obj.GetType() == typeof(DBNull) || list[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Visible;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (promptType.Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && _combo_Visibilities[b] == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					cmdFind_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else if (list[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && (cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Block-Var" || cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Sensor-Var"))
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_BLOCK.@xInt", "value"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						text3 = ((MMViewModel)this).GetFullBlockName("@main", text3);
						if (((MMViewModel)this).GetModelCategoryByBlockName(text3) == 14 || cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Sensor-Var")
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HybridVarVisible", (object)"1");
						}
						else
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"1");
						}
					}
				}
				if (promptType.Variable == "FVN_UOM")
				{
					Combo_AllowClear[b] = false;
				}
				else
				{
					Combo_AllowClear[b] = true;
				}
				if (_defineView != null)
				{
					object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_defineView).FindName("txtRowsvw_" + b);
					MMTextEdit val = (MMTextEdit)((obj2 is MMTextEdit) ? obj2 : null);
					object obj3 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_defineView).FindName("cboRowsvw_" + b);
					MMComboEdit val2 = (MMComboEdit)((obj3 is MMComboEdit) ? obj3 : null);
					object obj4 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_defineView).FindName("txtRowsvw_" + b);
					MMValueEdit val3 = (MMValueEdit)((obj4 is MMValueEdit) ? obj4 : null);
					if (flag || list[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val3 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val3).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val3 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val3).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
					}
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						if (list[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units && !((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled)
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = true;
						}
						else
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (list[j].ConvertToMixedCase)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("RowsvwD_" + b + "_IsMixedCase", (object)"1");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("RowsvwD_" + b + "_IsMixedCase", (object)"0");
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("vwrow" + b, (object)promptType.Variable);
				b++;
				if (b > 7)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int k = b; k <= 7; k++)
			{
				_label_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_combo_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_textEdit_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Captions");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Combo_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("TextEdit_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cmdFind_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Combo_AllowClear");
		}

		public static List<VarType> VAGetVarIndex(List<VarType> VarTypes, ObjType oType)
		{
			List<VarType> list = new List<VarType>();
			switch (oType)
			{
			case ObjType.otAll:
				list = VarTypes;
				break;
			case ObjType.otBlock:
				foreach (VarType VarType in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType.UCase == "BLOCK-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "BLOCK-VEC" || VarType.UCase == "MEAS-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "CONT-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "CONFIG-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otStream:
				foreach (VarType VarType2 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "MOLE-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "MOLE-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "MASS-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "MASS-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "STDVOL-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "STDVOL-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-PROP" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSTRM-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "COMPATTR-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "COMPATTR-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSATTR-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSATTR-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-DUTY" || VarType2.UCase == "WORK-POWER" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-TEMP" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-TEND" || VarType2.UCase == "QVEC" || VarType2.UCase == "TVEC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-COST" || VarType2.UCase == "POWER-POWER")
					{
						list.Add(VarType2);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otUtility:
				foreach (VarType VarType3 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType3.UCase == "PARAMETER" || VarType3.UCase == "LOCAL-PARAM" || VarType3.UCase == "BALANCE-VAR" || VarType3.UCase == "PRESR-VAR" || VarType3.UCase == "UTILITY")
					{
						list.Add(VarType3);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otProperty:
				foreach (VarType VarType4 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType4.UCase == "UNARY-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "UNARY-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "UN-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "GROUP-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "GROUP-BI-PAR" || VarType4.UCase == "GR-BI-COR-EL")
					{
						list.Add(VarType4);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otReactions:
				foreach (VarType VarType5 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType5.UCase == "CHEM-VAR" || VarType5.UCase == "REACT-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType5);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otSensor:
				foreach (VarType VarType6 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType6.UCase == "SENSOR-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType6);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otCosting:
				foreach (VarType VarType7 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType7.UCase == "BYPROD-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "CAPITAL-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "CBLOCK-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "LABOR-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "OPER-COST-VA" || VarType7.UCase == "PRODUCT-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "PROFIT-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "RAW-MAT-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "STARTUP-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "UNIT-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "UTILITY-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "WASTE-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "WORK-CAP-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType7);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otOther:
				foreach (VarType VarType8 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType8.UCase == "MEAS-VAR" || VarType8.UCase == "CONT-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType8);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static string VAVarFindMCase(List<VarType> VarTypes, string UCase)
		{
			string result = null;
			foreach (VarType VarType in VarTypes)
			{
				if (UCase == VarType.UCase)
				{
					result = VarType.MCase;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static int VAVarFindUCaseIndex(List<VarType> VarTypes, string UCase)
		{
			int result = -1;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (VarType VarType in VarTypes)
			{
				if (UCase == VarType.UCase)
				{
					result = num;
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override bool PasteVariable(IEnumerable<string> paths)
		{
			if (paths != null && paths.Count() > 0)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				string[] oldIds = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "child_ids"));
				foreach (string path in paths)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
					{
						SmgeExtensions.SMVariableAccessingParse((MMViewModel)(object)this, path, (VarAcessType)0, ref flag);
					}
				}
				UpdateSelectedRow(oldIds);
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
				return true;
			}
			return ((MMViewModel)this).PasteVariable(paths);
		}

		private void SetSelectedVariableForMMEOBrowseEditor(string xVarName)
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("xVarName", (object)xVarName);
			object obj = ((FrameworkElement)(object)_defineView)?.FindName("txtOpenVariable");
			MMEOBrowseEditor val = (MMEOBrowseEditor)((obj is MMEOBrowseEditor) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.IsUpdateRequired = true;
			}
		}

	public class VRowMaskConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value as Type == typeof(double))
			{
				return (object)(AesMaskOption)2;
			}
			return (object)(AesMaskOption)0;
		}

		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

				_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = text;
				if (_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue != null)
				{
					foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item in MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "option_list"))))
					{
						if (item.UCase == _cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue)

							_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = item.MCase;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return _cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue;
			}
			set
			{
				string text = _cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue;
				_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = value;
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
				if (!(_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue != text))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item in MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "option_list"))))
				{
					if (item.MCase == _cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue)
					{
						_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = item.UCase;
						break;
					}
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE.@xInt", "value", (object)_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue);
				Display2();
			}
		}

		private void cmdFind_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			string selectedItem = val.SelectedItem;
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < val.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (val.Items[i].Display == selectedItem)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			MmgExtensions.GxSearchVariable((MMViewModel)(object)this, ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main"), num + 1, selectedItem, "", "DEFINE");
			Display2();
			((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
			((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
		}

		private void cmdClose_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			((MMViewModel)this).CloseForm();
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				DoVarnameChange();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
			if (pd.Name == "optCategory_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				object obj = optCategory_MultiMap;
				CxvMultiMapPropertyData val = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((obj is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null && val.Value != null)
				{
					string optVal = val.Value.ToString();
					UpdateVarTypeOptions(optVal);
					Display2();
				}
			}
			else if (pd.Name == "mnuVarname_ListVar" && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				DoVarnameChange();
			}
			else if (subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				Display2();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVarTypeOptions(string optVal)
		{
			ObjType objType = optVal switch
			{
				"ALL" => ObjType.otAll, 
				"BLOCK" => ObjType.otBlock, 
				"STREAM" => ObjType.otStream, 
				"MODUT" => ObjType.otUtility, 
				"PROP" => ObjType.otProperty, 
				"REACT" => ObjType.otReactions, 
				"COST" => ObjType.otCosting, 
				_ => ObjType.otAll, 
			};
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list = MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "option_list")));
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (objType == ObjType.otAll)
			{
				if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
				{
					cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
				}
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
				{
					foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item in list)
					{
						cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item.MCase);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list2 = VAGetVarIndex(list, objType);
			if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
			}
			cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item2 in list2)
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item2.MCase);
			}
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE." + val.SelectedItem, "value"));
			if (text == null || VAVarFindUCaseIndex(list, text) == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item3 in list2)
			{
				if (text == item3.UCase)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			HideExtension();
			ClearVarType();
		}

		private void DoVarnameChange()
		{
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				string selectedItem = val.SelectedItem;
				string optVal = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_CATEG." + selectedItem, "value"));
				UpdateVarTypeOptions(optVal);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("xInt", (object)selectedItem);
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
			}
		}

			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
		}

		private void Display2()
		{
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.PromptType> list = MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAPromptInit();
			byte b = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < cmdFind_Visibilities.Length; i++)
			{
				cmdFind_Visibilities[i] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"0");
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.PromptType promptType = list[j];
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + promptType.Variable + ".@xInt", "can_enter"));
				if (text == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + promptType.Variable + ".@xInt", "value"));
				if (text2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = !(text == "1");
				if (flag && (!(promptType.Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units) || !(text2 != "")))
				{
					continue;
				}
				_label_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Visible;
				_label_captions[b] = list[j].Text;
				object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + promptType.Variable + ".@xInt", "option_list");
				if (obj == null || obj.GetType() == typeof(DBNull) || list[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Visible;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (promptType.Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && _combo_Visibilities[b] == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					cmdFind_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Visible;
					ComboWidth[b] = 154;
				}
				else if (list[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && (cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Block-Var" || cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Sensor-Var"))
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[b] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"1");
				}
				else
				{
					ComboWidth[b] = 182;
				}
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMDesignSpe_Input_VarWiz mMDesignSpe_Input_VarWiz)
				{
					object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMDesignSpe_Input_VarWiz).FindName("txtRowsvw_" + b);
					MMTextEdit val = (MMTextEdit)((obj2 is MMTextEdit) ? obj2 : null);
					object obj3 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMDesignSpe_Input_VarWiz).FindName("cboRowsvw_" + b);
					MMComboEdit val2 = (MMComboEdit)((obj3 is MMComboEdit) ? obj3 : null);
					object obj4 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMDesignSpe_Input_VarWiz).FindName("txtRowsvw_" + b);
					MMValueEdit val3 = (MMValueEdit)((obj4 is MMValueEdit) ? obj4 : null);
					if (flag || list[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val3 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val3).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val3 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val3).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
					}
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						if (list[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units && !((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled)
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = true;
						}
						else
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (list[j].ConvertToMixedCase)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Rowsvw_" + b + "_IsMixedCase", (object)"1");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Rowsvw_" + b + "_IsMixedCase", (object)"0");
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("vwrow" + b, (object)promptType.Variable);
				b++;
				if (b > 7)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int k = b; k <= 7; k++)
			{
				_label_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_combo_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_textEdit_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Captions");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Combo_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("TextEdit_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cmdFind_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("ComboWidth");
		}

		public List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VAGetVarIndex(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, ObjType oType)
		{
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list = new List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType>();
			switch (oType)
			{
			case ObjType.otAll:
				list = VarTypes;
				break;
			case ObjType.otBlock:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType.UCase == "BLOCK-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "BLOCK-VEC" || VarType.UCase == "MEAS-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "CONT-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "CONFIG-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otStream:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType2 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "MOLE-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "MOLE-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "MASS-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "MASS-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "STDVOL-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "STDVOL-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-PROP" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSTRM-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "COMPATTR-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "COMPATTR-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSATTR-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSATTR-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-DUTY" || VarType2.UCase == "WORK-POWER" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-TEMP" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-TEND" || VarType2.UCase == "QVEC" || VarType2.UCase == "TVEC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-COST" || VarType2.UCase == "POWER-POWER")
					{
						list.Add(VarType2);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otUtility:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType3 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType3.UCase == "PARAMETER" || VarType3.UCase == "LOCAL-PARAM" || VarType3.UCase == "BALANCE-VAR" || VarType3.UCase == "PRESR-VAR" || VarType3.UCase == "UTILITY")
					{
						list.Add(VarType3);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otProperty:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType4 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType4.UCase == "UNARY-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "UNARY-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "UN-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "GROUP-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "GROUP-BI-PAR" || VarType4.UCase == "GR-BI-COR-EL")
					{
						list.Add(VarType4);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otReactions:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType5 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType5.UCase == "CHEM-VAR" || VarType5.UCase == "REACT-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType5);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otCosting:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType6 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType6.UCase == "BYPROD-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "CAPITAL-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "CBLOCK-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "LABOR-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "OPER-COST-VA" || VarType6.UCase == "PRODUCT-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "PROFIT-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "RAW-MAT-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "STARTUP-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "UNIT-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "UTILITY-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "WASTE-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "WORK-CAP-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType6);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otOther:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType7 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType7.UCase == "MEAS-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "CONT-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType7);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public string VAVarFindMCase(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, string UCase)
		{
			string result = null;
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
			{
				if (UCase == VarType.UCase)
				{
					result = VarType.MCase;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public int VAVarFindUCaseIndex(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, string UCase)
		{
			int result = -1;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
			{
				if (UCase == VarType.UCase)
				{
					result = num;
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> _types
		{
			get
			{
				List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> varTypes = MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarTypes;
				if (varTypes == null)
				{
					MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.InitializeVaVar((CxvViewModel)(object)this);
				}
				return varTypes;
			}
		}

		public string cboVarType_Value
		{
			get
			{
				string result = null;
				string type = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "cboVarType_var1.Value"));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(type))
				{
					result = _types.Find((MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType p) => string.Compare(p.UCase, type, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0).MCase;
				}
				_cboVarType_Value = result;
				return result;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_cboVarType_Value != value)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VARY_VARTYPE", "value", (object)_types.Find((MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType p) => string.Compare(value, p.MCase, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0).UCase);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarType_Value");
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<string> cboVarType_options
		{
			get
			{
				if (ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "cboVarType_var1.ValueOptions") is IEnumerable source)
				{
					List<string> list = source.Cast<string>().ToList();
					List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
					foreach (string o in list)
					{
						list2.Add(_types.Find((MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType p) => string.Compare(p.UCase, o, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0).MCase);
					}
					list2.Sort();
					return list2;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public object cboVarType_var1
		{
			get
			{
				object value = ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(cboVarType_var1_Property);
				CxvVariableData val = (CxvVariableData)((value is CxvVariableData) ? value : null);
				if (val.OptionPrompts != null)
				{
					Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> op in val.OptionPrompts)
					{
						MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType varType = _types.FirstOrDefault((MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType p) => string.Compare(p.UCase, op.Key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(varType.MCase) && !dictionary.ContainsKey(varType.MCase))
						{
							dictionary.Add(varType.MCase, op.Value);
						}
					}
					val.OptionPrompts.Clear();
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> item in dictionary)
					{
						val.OptionPrompts.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
					}
				}
				return val;
			}
		}

		private void cmdPaste_CommandExecute(object parameter)

		public override bool CanPasteVariable()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string asiFormatTextFromClipboard = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFormatTextFromClipboard();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(asiFormatTextFromClipboard))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(asiFormatTextFromClipboard, ((MMViewModel)this)._oldAsiFormatText))
			{
				((MMViewModel)this)._oldAsiFormatText = asiFormatTextFromClipboard;
				bool flag = false;
				if (((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider != null && ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case != null)
				{
					IList<string> list = ClipboardHelper.ParseCxsPathFromAsiFormat(asiFormatTextFromClipboard, ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, 1000000);
					if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
					{
						string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main") as string;
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							string value = text.ToLower().Replace("top.appmodelv8", string.Empty).Replace("top.appmodel", string.Empty);
							foreach (string item in list)
							{
								if (!item.ToLower().Replace("top.appmodelv8", string.Empty).Replace("top.appmodel", string.Empty)
									.Contains(value))
								{
									((MMViewModel)this)._newCanPaste = true;
									flag = true;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					((MMViewModel)this)._newCanPaste = false;
				}
			}
			return ((MMViewModel)this)._newCanPaste;
		}

		private void Display2()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < cmdFind_Visibility.Count; i++)
			{
				cmdFind_Visibility[i] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HybridVarVisible", (object)"0", true);
			int num = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < Prompts.Count; j++)
			{
				string text = "@main.Input." + Prompts[j].Variable;
				bool? flag = !CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text, "can_enter"));
				if ((!flag.HasValue || flag.Value) && (string.Compare(Prompts[j].Text, Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units, StringComparison.Ordinal) != 0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text, "value")))))
				{
					continue;
				}
				lblrows_Visibility[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				lblrows_Caption[num] = Prompts[j].Text;
				if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text, "option_list") == DBNull.Value || Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
				{
					cboRows_Visibility[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "cboVarType_var1.Value"));
					string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VARYBLOCK", "value"));
					text3 = ((MMViewModel)this).GetFullBlockName("@main", text3);
					int modelCategoryByBlockName = ((MMViewModel)this).GetModelCategoryByBlockName(text3);
					if (text2 == "Sensor-Var" || (text2 == "Block-Var" && modelCategoryByBlockName == 14))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HybridVarVisible", (object)"1", true);
					}
					else
					{
						txtRows_Visibility[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					cboRows_Visibility[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					txtRows_Visibility[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMDesignSpe_Input_Vary mMDesignSpe_Input_Vary)
				{
					object obj = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMDesignSpe_Input_Vary).FindName("txtRows_" + num);
					MMTextEdit val = (MMTextEdit)((obj is MMTextEdit) ? obj : null);
					object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMDesignSpe_Input_Vary).FindName("cboRows_" + num);
					MMComboEdit val2 = (MMComboEdit)((obj2 is MMComboEdit) ? obj2 : null);
					if ((flag.HasValue && flag.Value) || Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
					}
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						if (Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units && !((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled)
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = true;
						}
						else
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && cboRows_Visibility[num] == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					cmdFind_Visibility[num + 1] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (Prompts[j].ConvertToMixedCase)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Rowsvw_" + num + "_IsMixedCase", (object)"1");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Rowsvw_" + num + "_IsMixedCase", (object)"0");
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("row" + num.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), (object)Prompts[j].Variable);
				num++;
				if (num > 7)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int k = num; k <= 7; k++)
			{
				lblrows_Visibility[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				cboRows_Visibility[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				txtRows_Visibility[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public override bool PasteVariable(IEnumerable<string> paths)
		{
			if (paths != null && paths.Count() > 0)
			{
				cboVarType_Value = null;
				bool flag = false;

				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))

						SmgeExtensions.SMVariableAccessingParse((MMViewModel)(object)this, path, (VarAcessType)2, ref flag);
					}
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarType_Value");
				return true;
			}
			return ((MMViewModel)this).PasteVariable(paths);
		}

			public string VarDefn
			{
				get
				{
					string result = "";
					string text = "";
					string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y"));
					string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE." + text2, "value"));
					if (text3 == null)
					{
						return result;
					}
					foreach (VarType varType in VarTypes)
					{
						if (text3 == varType.UCase)
						{
							text = varType.MCase;
							break;
						}
					}
					foreach (PromptType prompt in Prompts)
					{
						string text4 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + prompt.Variable + "." + text2, "value"));
						string text5 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + prompt.Variable + "." + text2, "can_enter"));
						if (text5 == null)
						{
							text5 = "0";
						}
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4) && (!prompt.HideWhenLocked || text5 == "1"))
						{
							if (prompt.ConvertToMixedCase)
							{
								text4 = StrConvMixCase(text4);
							}
							text = text + " " + prompt.Label + text4;
						}
					}
					return text;
				}
			}
		}

		public static string StrConvMixCase(string InpVal)
		{
			string text = "";
			try
			{
				int result = 0;
				if (int.TryParse(InpVal, out result))
				{
					text = InpVal;
					return text;
				}
				string[] array = InpVal.Split('-');
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i].Length > 1)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + array[i].Substring(1).ToLower();
					}
					else if (array[i].Length > 0)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].ToUpper();
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length - 1; j++)
				{
					text = text + array[j] + "-";
				}
				text += array[array.Length - 1];
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return text;
		}

	public class MMCalcul_ExcelHost : System.Windows.Forms.UserControl
	{
		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer paintTimer;

		private object _excel;

		private IContainer components;

		public object ExcelObject
		{
			get
			{
				return _excel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_excel == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					if (_excel != null)
					{
						Marshal.ReleaseComObject(_excel);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				_excel = value;
			}
		}

		public CxsDataProvider DataProvider { get; set; }

		public string Path { get; set; }

		[DllImport("ole32.dll")]
		private static extern int OleRun([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.IUnknown)] object pExcelObject);

		[DllImport("ole32.dll")]
		private static extern int OleDraw([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.IUnknown)] object pExcelObject, uint dwAspect, IntPtr hdcDraw, [In] ref Rectangle lprcBounds);

		public MMCalcul_ExcelHost()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		private void timedPaint(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Invalidate();
			Update();
		}

		public void cancelPaintTimer()
		{
			if (paintTimer != null)
			{
				paintTimer.Dispose();
				paintTimer = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pea)
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Graphics graphics = pea.Graphics;
			try
			{
				if (ExcelObject != null && DataProvider != null)
				{
					if (DataProvider.Case == null || DataProvider.Case.Solver == null || (int)DataProvider.Case.Solver.RunState == 2)
					{
						graphics.Clear(Color.LightGray);
					}
					else
					{
						graphics.Clear(Color.White);
						IntPtr hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
						double num = base.ClientRectangle.Width - 2;
						double num2 = base.ClientRectangle.Height - 2;
						Rectangle lprcBounds = new Rectangle(1, 1, (int)num, (int)num2);
						try
						{
							OleRun(ExcelObject);
							OleDraw(ExcelObject, 1u, hdc, ref lprcBounds);
							graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
							graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
							graphics.Clear(Color.LightGray);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.Clear(Color.LightGray);
				}
				graphics.DrawRectangle(Pens.Black, 0, 0, base.ClientRectangle.Width - 1, base.ClientRectangle.Height - 1);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public void Edit()
		{
			if (DataProvider == null || ExcelObject == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				CxvActionResult val = DataProvider.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "HappNode", false, new object[1] { Path });
				if (val.Succeeded)
				{
					object result = val.Result;
					Type type = result.GetType();
					object[] args = new object[1] { -2 };
					type.InvokeMember("DoObjectVerb", BindingFlags.InvokeMethod, null, result, args);
					ExcelObject.GetType().InvokeMember("Activate", BindingFlags.InvokeMethod, null, ExcelObject, null);
					if (paintTimer == null)
					{
						paintTimer = new System.Windows.Forms.Timer();
						paintTimer.Interval = 5000;
						paintTimer.Tick += timedPaint;
						paintTimer.Start();
					}
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(type);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			base.SuspendLayout();
			base.AutoScaleDimensions = new System.Drawing.SizeF(6f, 13f);
			base.AutoScaleMode = System.Windows.Forms.AutoScaleMode.Font;
			this.DoubleBuffered = true;
			base.Name = "MMCalcul_ExcelHost";
			base.ResumeLayout(false);
		}

		private void cmdBrowse_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Microsoft.Win32.OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new Microsoft.Win32.OpenFileDialog();
			openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			string filter = ApwnResources.NeuralNetworkFiles + " (*.fnn)|*.fnn";
			openFileDialog.Filter = filter;
			openFileDialog.Title = ApwnResources.SelectNeuralNetworkFile;
			openFileDialog.ReadOnlyChecked = true;
			bool? flag = openFileDialog.ShowDialog();
			if (!flag.HasValue || !flag.Value)
			{
				return;
			}
			string fileName = openFileDialog.FileName;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				string text = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData) + "\\AspenTech\\AIModeling\\MergeNNFiles";
				if (!Directory.Exists(text))
				{
					Directory.CreateDirectory(text);
				}
				string text2 = Path.Combine(text, Path.GetFileName(fileName));
				if (!File.Exists(text2))
				{
					File.Copy(fileName, text2);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			fileName = Path.GetFileName(fileName);
			if (fileName.Length >= 219)
			{
				fileName = fileName.Substring(0, 219);
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.FNN_FILE", "value", (object)fileName);
		}

		private void RefreshSpreadsheet()
		{

			{
				string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");

			}
			int handleValue = GetHandleValue();
			if (handleValue == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (num == 3)
			{
				if (SingleSpreadsheet.GetInstance().OpenedSpreadsheetHandleCollection.Contains(handleValue) && !(((MMViewModel)this).View as MMCalcul_Input_Calcul).GetSpreadsheetVisibility())
				{
					(((MMViewModel)this).View as MMCalcul_Input_Calcul).InitSpreadsheetControlHandleAndVisibility(GetHandleValue(), isValid: false);
				}
				else
				{
					(((MMViewModel)this).View as MMCalcul_Input_Calcul).InitSpreadsheetControlHandleAndVisibility(GetHandleValue(), isValid: true);
				}
				return;
			}
			(((MMViewModel)this).View as MMCalcul_Input_Calcul).ChangeSpreadsheetVisibility(isVisible: false);
			(((MMViewModel)this).View as MMCalcul_Input_Calcul).DisplayMultipleSpreadsheetWarning(isVisible: false);
			if (SingleSpreadsheet.GetInstance().OpenedSpreadsheetHandleCollection.Contains(handleValue))
			{
				SingleSpreadsheet.GetInstance().OpenedSpreadsheetHandleCollection.Remove(handleValue);
			}
		}

	public class MMCalcul_Input_Calcul : MMTabPage, IComponentConnector

		public MMCalcul_Input_Calcul()
		{
			((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModelType = typeof(MMCalcul_Input_Calcul_ViewModel);
			InitializeComponent();
			((FrameworkElement)this).Loaded += MMCalcul_Input_Calcul_Loaded;
			host.IsVisibleChanged += host_IsVisibleChanged;
			host.Loaded += host_Loaded;
			host.Unloaded += host_Unloaded;
		}

		private void host_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ExcelHost != null)
			{
				ExcelHost.cancelPaintTimer();
			}
		}

		private void host_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateExellSize();
		}

		private void host_IsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)MMFortran1).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)(object)MMFortran1).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			UpdateExellSize();
		}

		private void MMCalcul_Input_Calcul_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sv == null)
			{
				sv = Utilities.GetDescendantFromType((DependencyObject)(object)this, typeof(ScrollViewer), true) as ScrollViewer;
			}
			if (sv != null)
			{
				sv.ScrollChanged += sv_ScrollChanged;
			}
		}

		private void sv_ScrollChanged(object sender, ScrollChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateExellSize();
		}

		private void ExcelHost_DoubleClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			(((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModel as MMCalcul_Input_Calcul_ViewModel).cmdEditExcel_Command.Execute(null);
		}

		private void UpdateExellSize()
		{
			if (host != null && host.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && host.IsLoaded && sv != null)
			{
				double num = sv.ViewportHeight - gdRoot.RowDefinitions[0].ActualHeight - gdRoot.Margin.Top - gdRoot.Margin.Bottom - 16.0;
				double num2 = sv.ViewportWidth - gdRoot.Margin.Left - gdRoot.Margin.Right - 16.0;
				if (num >= 0.0 && num2 >= 0.0)
				{
					host.Height = num;
					host.Width = num2;
					host.Margin = new Thickness(8.0 + sv.HorizontalOffset, 8.0 + sv.VerticalOffset, 8.0, 8.0);
				}
				else if (num < 0.0)
				{
					host.Height = 0.0;
					host.Margin = new Thickness(8.0 + sv.HorizontalOffset, 8.0 + sv.VerticalOffset, 8.0, 8.0);
				}
				else
				{
					host.Width = 0.0;
					host.Margin = new Thickness(8.0 + sv.HorizontalOffset, 8.0 + sv.VerticalOffset, 8.0, 8.0);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshSpreadsheetControl()
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				MMSpreadsheetControl1.Refresh();
			}
		}

		internal void SaveSpreadsheet()
		{
			MMSpreadsheetControl1?.SaveSpreadsheetChanges();
		}

		public void CloseSpreadsheet()
		{
			MMSpreadsheetControl1.Close();
			MMSpreadsheetControl1.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		internal void InitSpreadsheetControlHandleAndVisibility(int handle, bool isValid)
		{
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (!isValid || handle <= 0)
				{
					DisplayMultipleSpreadsheetWarning(isVisible: true);
					DeleteSpreadsheetControl();
				}
				else
				{
					if (!SingleSpreadsheet.GetInstance().OpenedSpreadsheetHandleCollection.Contains(handle))
					{
						if (RootGrid.Children.Count > 1)
						{
							SingleSpreadsheet.GetInstance().OpenedSpreadsheetHandleCollection.Add(handle);
						}
					}
					else if (MMSpreadsheetControl1.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
					{
						DisplayMultipleSpreadsheetWarning(isVisible: true);
						DeleteSpreadsheetControl();
						return;
					}
					if (MMSpreadsheetControl1.ControlViewModel == null)
					{
						MMSpreadsheetControl mMSpreadsheetControl = MMSpreadsheetControl1;
						CxvViewModel viewModel = ((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModel;
						mMSpreadsheetControl.ControlViewModel = (MMViewModel)(object)((viewModel is MMViewModel) ? viewModel : null);
					}
					MMSpreadsheetControl1.SpreasheetHandle = handle;
					DisplayMultipleSpreadsheetWarning(isVisible: false);
					ChangeSpreadsheetVisibility(isVisible: true);
				}
			});
		}

		internal void DisplayMultipleSpreadsheetWarning(bool isVisible)
		{
			if (isVisible)
			{
				WarningTextBlock.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				WarningTextBlock.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		internal void ChangeSpreadsheetVisibility(bool isVisible)
		{
			if (RootGrid.Children.Count <= 1)
			{
				WarningTextBlock.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else if (isVisible)
			{
				if (MMSpreadsheetControl1.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
				{
					MMSpreadsheetControl1.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					MMSpreadsheetControl1.InitRibbon();
				}
			}
			else if (MMSpreadsheetControl1.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				MMSpreadsheetControl1.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				MMSpreadsheetControl1.SaveSpreadsheetChanges();
			}
		}

		internal void DeleteSpreadsheetControl()
		{
			if (RootGrid.Children.Count > 1)
			{
				RootGrid.Children.RemoveAt(1);
			}
		}

		internal bool GetSpreadsheetVisibility()
		{
			if (RootGrid.Children.Count <= 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MMSpreadsheetControl1.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static string StrConvMixCase(string InpVal)
		{
			string text = "";
			try
			{
				int result = 0;
				if (int.TryParse(InpVal, out result))
				{
					text = InpVal;
					return text;
				}
				string[] array = InpVal.Split('-');
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i].Length > 1)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + array[i].Substring(1).ToLower();
					}
					else if (array[i].Length > 0)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].ToUpper();
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length - 1; j++)
				{
					text = text + array[j] + "-";
				}
				text += array[array.Length - 1];
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return text;
		}

					return false;
				}
			}
			string name = "SOFTWARE\\AspenTech\\Aspen OnLine\\" + text3;
			RegistryKey registryKey2 = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(name, writable: false);

		private void SetOptInformationFlow()
		{
			string currentVar = CurrentVar;
			if (IsTearVar(currentVar))
			{
				oldIndex = 2;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value", (object)"optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_3");
			}
			else if (IsRWVar(currentVar, readCollectionPath))
			{
				oldIndex = 0;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value", (object)"optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_1");
			}
			else if (IsRWVar(currentVar, writeCollectionPath))
			{
				oldIndex = 1;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value", (object)"optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_2");
			}
			else
			{
				oldIndex = -1;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value", (object)"optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_4");
			}
		}

		private bool IsTearVar(string name)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(scaleCollectionPath, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new string[0];
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array2[i].Equals(name, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsRWVar(string name, string path)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new string[0];
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path + "." + text, "value")).Equals(name, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetRWTVal(string name)
		{
			if (IsTearVar(name))
			{
				return 2;
			}
			if (IsRWVar(name, readCollectionPath))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			IsRWVar(name, writeCollectionPath);
			return 1;
		}

		private void SetRWVar(int RW, string path, bool value)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new string[0];
			}
			if (!value)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path + "." + array[i], "value")).Equals(CurrentVar, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChild(path, i);
						break;
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path + "." + array[j], "value")).Equals(CurrentVar, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).AddChild(path, array.Length);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(path + ".#" + array.Length, "value", (object)CurrentVar);
		}

		private void SetTearVar(bool value)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(scaleCollectionPath, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new string[0];
			}
			if (!value)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i].Equals(CurrentVar, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChild(scaleCollectionPath, i);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (!array.Contains(CurrentVar))
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).AddChild(scaleCollectionPath, array.Length);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(scaleCollectionPath + ".#" + array.Length, "id", (object)CurrentVar);
			}
		}

		{
			if (pd.Name == "optInformationFlow_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")

				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value"));
				switch (oldIndex)
				{
				case -1:
					switch (text2)

					}

						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: false);
						_inEditing = false;
						SetRWVar(0, readCollectionPath, value: true);
						break;
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_3":
						SetTearVar(value: true);
						break;
					}
					break;

						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: false);
						_inEditing = false;
						SetRWVar(0, readCollectionPath, value: true);
						break;
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_2":
						SetTearVar(value: false);
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
				switch (text2)

					oldIndex = 0;
					break;
				case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_2":
					oldIndex = 1;
					break;
				case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_3":
					oldIndex = 2;
					break;
				case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_4":
					if (oldIndex != -1)
					{
						oldIndex = -1;

						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: false);
						_inEditing = false;
						SetRWVar(0, readCollectionPath, value: false);
					}
					break;

			}

			}
			else if (pd.Name != "optInformationFlow_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{

			}
			else if (pd.Name == "IsNeuralNetwork" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{

			}

				{
					continue;
				}
				string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + item.Variable + ".@xInt", "value"));
				if (text3 == null || (ExtraPromptsForNeuralNetwork.Contains(item) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = !(text2 == "1");
				if (flag && (!(item.Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units) || !(text3 != "")))
				{
					continue;
				}
				_label_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				_label_captions[num] = PromptsForCurrentCalculator[j].Text;
				object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + item.Variable + ".@xInt", "option_list");
				if (obj == null || obj.GetType() == typeof(DBNull) || PromptsForCurrentCalculator[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (item.Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && _combo_Visibilities[num] == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					cmdFind_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					ComboWidth[num] = 151;

				else if (PromptsForCurrentCalculator[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && (cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Block-Var" || cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Sensor-Var"))
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					string text4 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_BLOCK.@xInt", "value"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
					{

						if (((MMViewModel)this).GetModelCategoryByBlockName(text4) == 14 || cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Sensor-Var")

						}
						else
						{
							((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"1");
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ComboWidth[num] = 179;
				}
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMCalcul_Input_Define mMCalcul_Input_Define)
				{
					object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMCalcul_Input_Define).FindName("txtRowsvw_" + num);
					MMTextEdit val = (MMTextEdit)((obj2 is MMTextEdit) ? obj2 : null);
					object obj3 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMCalcul_Input_Define).FindName("cboRowsvw_" + num);
					MMComboEdit val2 = (MMComboEdit)((obj3 is MMComboEdit) ? obj3 : null);
					object obj4 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMCalcul_Input_Define).FindName("txtRowsvw_" + num);
					MMValueEdit val3 = (MMValueEdit)((obj4 is MMValueEdit) ? obj4 : null);
					if (flag || PromptsForCurrentCalculator[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)

			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cmdFind_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("ComboWidth");

		public List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VAGetVarIndex(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, ObjType oType)
		{
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list = new List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType>();
			switch (oType)
			{
			case ObjType.otAll:
				list = VarTypes;
				break;
			case ObjType.otBlock:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType.UCase == "BLOCK-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "BLOCK-VEC" || VarType.UCase == "MEAS-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "CONT-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "CONFIG-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otStream:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType2 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "MOLE-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "MOLE-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "MASS-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "MASS-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "STDVOL-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "STDVOL-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-PROP" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSTRM-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "COMPATTR-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "COMPATTR-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSATTR-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSATTR-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-DUTY" || VarType2.UCase == "WORK-POWER" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-TEMP" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-TEND" || VarType2.UCase == "QVEC" || VarType2.UCase == "TVEC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-COST" || VarType2.UCase == "POWER-POWER")
					{
						list.Add(VarType2);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otUtility:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType3 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType3.UCase == "PARAMETER" || VarType3.UCase == "LOCAL-PARAM" || VarType3.UCase == "BALANCE-VAR" || VarType3.UCase == "PRESR-VAR" || VarType3.UCase == "UTILITY")
					{
						list.Add(VarType3);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otProperty:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType4 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType4.UCase == "UNARY-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "UNARY-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "UN-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "GROUP-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "GROUP-BI-PAR" || VarType4.UCase == "GR-BI-COR-EL")
					{
						list.Add(VarType4);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otReactions:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType5 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType5.UCase == "CHEM-VAR" || VarType5.UCase == "REACT-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType5);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otSensor:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType6 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType6.UCase == "SENSOR-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType6);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otCosting:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType7 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType7.UCase == "BYPROD-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "CAPITAL-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "CBLOCK-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "LABOR-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "OPER-COST-VA" || VarType7.UCase == "PRODUCT-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "PROFIT-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "RAW-MAT-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "STARTUP-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "UNIT-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "UTILITY-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "WASTE-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "WORK-CAP-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType7);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otOther:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType8 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType8.UCase == "MEAS-VAR" || VarType8.UCase == "CONT-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType8);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public string VAVarFindMCase(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, string UCase)
		{
			string result = null;
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
			{
				if (UCase == VarType.UCase)
				{
					result = VarType.MCase;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public int VAVarFindUCaseIndex(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, string UCase)
		{
			int result = -1;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
			{
				if (UCase == VarType.UCase)
				{
					result = num;
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateVarTypeOptions(string optVal)
		{
			ObjType objType;
			switch (optVal)
			{
			case "optCategory_MultiMapOption_1":
			case "ALL":
				objType = ObjType.otAll;
				break;
			case "optCategory_MultiMapOption_2":
			case "BLOCK":
				objType = ObjType.otBlock;
				break;
			case "optCategory_MultiMapOption_3":
			case "STREAM":
				objType = ObjType.otStream;
				break;
			case "optCategory_MultiMapOption_4":
			case "MODUT":
				objType = ObjType.otUtility;
				break;
			case "optCategory_MultiMapOption_5":
			case "PROP":
				objType = ObjType.otProperty;
				break;
			case "optCategory_MultiMapOption_6":
			case "REACT":
				objType = ObjType.otReactions;
				break;
			case "optCategory_MultiMapOption_7":
			case "SENSOR":
				objType = ObjType.otSensor;
				break;
			default:
				objType = ObjType.otAll;
				break;
			}
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list = MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "option_list")));
			if (objType == ObjType.otAll)
			{
				if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
				{
					cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
				}
				if (cboVarTypevw_var2.SequenceEqual(list.Select((MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType p) => p.MCase)))
				{
					return;
				}
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
				{
					foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item in list)
					{
						cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item.MCase);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list2 = VAGetVarIndex(list, objType);
			if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
			}
			if (!cboVarTypevw_var2.SequenceEqual(list2.Select((MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType p) => p.MCase)))
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item2 in list2)
				{
					cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item2.MCase);
				}
			}
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE." + val.SelectedItem, "value"));
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (VAVarFindUCaseIndex(list, text) == -1)
			{
				if (objType == ObjType.otSensor)
				{
					SetSensorVarType();
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item3 in list2)
			{
				if (text == item3.UCase)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ClearVarType();
		}

		private void DoVarnameChange()
		{
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				string selectedItem = val.SelectedItem;
				string optVal = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_CATEG." + selectedItem, "value"));
				UpdateVarTypeOptions(optVal);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("xInt", (object)selectedItem);
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("VarTypePrompts");
			}
		}

		private void SetOptInformationFlow()
		{
			string currentVar = CurrentVar;
			if (IsTearVar(currentVar))
			{
				oldIndex = 2;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value", (object)"optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_3");
			}
			else if (IsRWVar(currentVar, readCollectionPath))
			{
				oldIndex = 0;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value", (object)"optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_1");
			}
			else if (IsRWVar(currentVar, writeCollectionPath))
			{
				oldIndex = 1;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value", (object)"optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_2");
			}
			else

				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value", (object)"optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_4");
			}
		}

		private bool IsTearVar(string name)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(scaleCollectionPath, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new string[0];
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array2[i].Equals(name, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsRWVar(string name, string path)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new string[0];
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path + "." + text, "value")).Equals(name, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetRWTVal(string name)
		{
			if (IsTearVar(name))
			{
				return 2;
			}
			if (IsRWVar(name, readCollectionPath))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			IsRWVar(name, writeCollectionPath);
			return 1;
		}

		private void SetRWVar(int RW, string path, bool value)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new string[0];
			}
			if (!value)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(path + "." + array[i], "value")).Equals(CurrentVar, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChild(path, i);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).AddChild(path, array.Length);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(path + ".#" + array.Length, "value", (object)CurrentVar);
			}
		}

		private void SetTearVar(bool value)
		{
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(scaleCollectionPath, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new string[0];
			}
			if (!value)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i].Equals(CurrentVar, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChild(scaleCollectionPath, i);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).AddChild(scaleCollectionPath, array.Length);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(scaleCollectionPath + ".#" + array.Length, "id", (object)CurrentVar);
			}
		}
