		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "optInformationFlow_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "mnuVarname_StoVar.Value"))))
				{
					return;
				}
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "optInformationFlow_MultiMap.Value"));
				switch (oldIndex)
				{
				case -1:
					switch (text)
					{
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_1":
						SetRWVar(0, readCollectionPath, value: true);
						break;
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_2":
						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: true);
						break;
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_3":
						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: true);
						SetTearVar(value: true);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case 0:
					switch (text)
					{
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_2":
						SetRWVar(0, readCollectionPath, value: false);
						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: true);
						break;
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_3":
						SetRWVar(0, readCollectionPath, value: false);
						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: true);
						SetTearVar(value: true);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case 1:
					switch (text)
					{
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_1":
						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: false);
						SetRWVar(0, readCollectionPath, value: true);
						break;
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_3":
						SetTearVar(value: true);
						break;
					}
					break;
				case 2:
					switch (text)
					{
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_1":
						SetTearVar(value: false);
						SetRWVar(1, writeCollectionPath, value: false);
						SetRWVar(0, readCollectionPath, value: true);
						break;
					case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_2":
						SetTearVar(value: false);
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
				switch (text)
				{
				case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_1":
					oldIndex = 0;
					break;
				case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_2":
					oldIndex = 1;
					break;
				case "optInformationFlow_MultiMapOption_3":
					oldIndex = 2;
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (pd.Name == "optCategory_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				object obj = optCategory_MultiMap;
				CxvMultiMapPropertyData val = (CxvMultiMapPropertyData)((obj is CxvMultiMapPropertyData) ? obj : null);
				if (val == null || val.SelectedItem == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				string optVal = val.Value.ToString();
				UpdateVarTypeOptions(optVal);
				Display2();
			}
			else if (pd.Name == "mnuVarname_ListVar" && subPropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				DoVarnameChange();
			}
			else if (subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				Display2();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private void Display2()
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("xInt"));
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARIABLE." + text, "id"));
			SetCurrentVar(text2);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < cmdFind_Visibilities.Length; i++)
			{
				cmdFind_Visibilities[i] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"0");
			for (int j = 0; j < Prompts.Length; j++)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + Prompts[j].Variable + "." + text2, "can_enter"));
				string value = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + Prompts[j].Variable + "." + text2, "value"));
				flag = !num2.HasValue || num2.Value == 0;
				if (flag && (!(Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				_label_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				_label_captions[num] = Prompts[j].Text;
				object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + Prompts[j].Variable + "." + text2, "option_list");
				if (obj == null || obj.GetType() == typeof(DBNull) || Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && _combo_Visibilities[num] == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					cmdFind_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Visible;
					ComboWidth[num] = 151;
				}
				else if (Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Variable && (cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Block-Var" || cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue == "Sensor-Var"))
				{
					_combo_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					_textEdit_Visibilities[num] = Visibility.Collapsed;
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_BlockVarVisible", (object)"1");
				}
				else
				{
					ComboWidth[num] = 179;
				}
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMCalcul_Input_VarWizard mMCalcul_Input_VarWizard)
				{
					object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMCalcul_Input_VarWizard).FindName("txtRowsvw_" + num);
					MMTextEdit val = (MMTextEdit)((obj2 is MMTextEdit) ? obj2 : null);
					object obj3 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMCalcul_Input_VarWizard).FindName("cboRowsvw_" + num);
					MMComboEdit val2 = (MMComboEdit)((obj3 is MMComboEdit) ? obj3 : null);
					object obj4 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)mMCalcul_Input_VarWizard).FindName("txtRowsvw_" + num);
					MMValueEdit val3 = (MMValueEdit)((obj4 is MMValueEdit) ? obj4 : null);
					if (flag || Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Sentence)
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
						if (val3 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val3).IsMMEnabled = false;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
						if (val3 != null)
						{
							((AesControlBase)val3).IsMMEnabled = true;
						}
					}
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						if (Prompts[j].Text == Resources.MMCalcul_Input_Define_ViewModel__Units && !((AesControlBase)val2).IsMMEnabled)
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = true;
						}
						else
						{
							((AesComboEdit)val2).DisplayAsTextBox = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (Prompts[j].ConvertToMixedCase)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Rowsvw_" + num + "_IsMixedCase", (object)"1");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Rowsvw_" + num + "_IsMixedCase", (object)"0");
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"vwrow{num}", (object)Prompts[j].Variable);
				num++;
				if (num > 7)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int k = num; k <= 7; k++)
			{
				_label_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_combo_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
				_textEdit_Visibilities[k] = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Captions");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Label_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Combo_Visibilities");

			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cmdFind_Visibilities");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("ComboWidth");
		}

		public List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VAGetVarIndex(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, ObjType oType)
		{
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list = new List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType>();
			switch (oType)
			{
			case ObjType.otAll:
				list = VarTypes;
				break;
			case ObjType.otBlock:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType.UCase == "BLOCK-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "BLOCK-VEC" || VarType.UCase == "MEAS-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "CONT-VAR" || VarType.UCase == "CONFIG-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otStream:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType2 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "MOLE-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "MOLE-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "MASS-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "MASS-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "STDVOL-FLOW" || VarType2.UCase == "STDVOL-FRAC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-PROP" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSTRM-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "COMPATTR-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "COMPATTR-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSATTR-VAR" || VarType2.UCase == "SUBSATTR-VEC" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-DUTY" || VarType2.UCase == "WORK-POWER" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-TEMP" || VarType2.UCase == "HEAT-TEND" || VarType2.UCase == "QVEC" || VarType2.UCase == "TVEC" || VarType2.UCase == "STREAM-COST" || VarType2.UCase == "POWER-POWER")
					{
						list.Add(VarType2);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otUtility:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType3 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType3.UCase == "PARAMETER" || VarType3.UCase == "LOCAL-PARAM" || VarType3.UCase == "BALANCE-VAR" || VarType3.UCase == "PRESR-VAR" || VarType3.UCase == "UTILITY")
					{
						list.Add(VarType3);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otProperty:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType4 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType4.UCase == "UNARY-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "UNARY-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "UN-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "BI-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-COR-EL" || VarType4.UCase == "NC-COR-VEC" || VarType4.UCase == "GROUP-PARAM" || VarType4.UCase == "GROUP-BI-PAR" || VarType4.UCase == "GR-BI-COR-EL")
					{
						list.Add(VarType4);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otReactions:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType5 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType5.UCase == "CHEM-VAR" || VarType5.UCase == "REACT-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType5);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otCosting:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType6 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType6.UCase == "BYPROD-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "CAPITAL-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "CBLOCK-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "LABOR-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "OPER-COST-VA" || VarType6.UCase == "PRODUCT-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "PROFIT-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "RAW-MAT-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "STARTUP-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "UNIT-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "UTILITY-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "WASTE-VAR" || VarType6.UCase == "WORK-CAP-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType6);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ObjType.otOther:
				foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType7 in VarTypes)
				{
					if (VarType7.UCase == "MEAS-VAR" || VarType7.UCase == "CONT-VAR")
					{
						list.Add(VarType7);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public string VAVarFindMCase(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, string UCase)
		{
			string result = null;
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
			{
				if (UCase == VarType.UCase)
				{
					result = VarType.MCase;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public int VAVarFindUCaseIndex(List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> VarTypes, string UCase)
		{
			int result = -1;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType VarType in VarTypes)
			{
				if (UCase == VarType.UCase)
				{
					result = num;
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateVarTypeOptions(string optVal)
		{
			ObjType objType = optVal switch
			{
				"optCategory_MultiMapOption_1" => ObjType.otAll, 
				"optCategory_MultiMapOption_2" => ObjType.otBlock, 
				"optCategory_MultiMapOption_3" => ObjType.otStream, 
				"optCategory_MultiMapOption_4" => ObjType.otUtility, 
				"optCategory_MultiMapOption_5" => ObjType.otProperty, 
				"optCategory_MultiMapOption_6" => ObjType.otReactions, 
				_ => ObjType.otAll, 
			};
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list = MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VAVarTypeInit(CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE", "option_list")));
			if (objType == ObjType.otAll)
			{
				if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
				{
					cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
				}
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
				{
					foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item in list)
					{
						cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item.MCase);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			List<MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType> list2 = VAGetVarIndex(list, objType);
			if (cboVarTypevw_var2 == null)
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2 = new ObservableCollection<string>();
			}
			cboVarTypevw_var2.Clear();
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item2 in list2)
			{
				cboVarTypevw_var2.Add(item2.MCase);
			}
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE." + val.SelectedItem, "value"));
			if (text == null || VAVarFindUCaseIndex(list, text) == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (MMDesignSpe_Input_Define_ViewModel.VarType item3 in list2)
			{
				if (text == item3.UCase)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ClearVarType();
		}

		private void DoVarnameChange()
		{
			object obj = mnuVarname_ListVar;
			CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData val = (CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData)((obj is CxvAdvCollectionPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				string selectedItem = val.SelectedItem;
				string optVal = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_CATEG." + selectedItem, "value"));
				UpdateVarTypeOptions(optVal);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("xInt", (object)selectedItem);
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");
			}
		}

		public class MMCalcul_Input_Define_Converter : MMViewModel, IValueConverter
		{
			public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				string result = "";
				string text = "";
				if (value == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				string text2 = value.ToString();
				string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE." + text2, "value"));
				if (text3 == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				foreach (VarType varType in VarTypes)
				{
					if (text3 == varType.UCase)
					{
						text = varType.MCase;
						break;
					}
				}
				foreach (PromptType prompt in Prompts)
				{
					string text4 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + prompt.Variable + "." + text2, "value"));
					string text5 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + prompt.Variable + "." + text2, "can_enter"));
					if (text5 == null)
					{
						text5 = "0";
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4) && (!prompt.HideWhenLocked || text5 == "1"))
					{
						if (prompt.ConvertToMixedCase)
						{
							text4 = StrConvMixCase(text4);
						}
						text = text + " " + prompt.Label + text4;
					}
				}
				return text;
			}

			public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public class PromptType
		{
			public string Text;

			public string Label;

			public string Variable;

			public bool HideWhenLocked;

			public bool ConvertToMixedCase;
		}

			public string MCase;

		public static string StrConvMixCase(string InpVal)
		{
			string text = "";
			try
			{
				int result = 0;
				if (int.TryParse(InpVal, out result))
				{
					text = InpVal;
					return text;
				}
				string[] array = InpVal.Split('-');
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i].Length > 1)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + array[i].Substring(1).ToLower();
					}
					else if (array[i].Length > 0)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].ToUpper();
					}
				}
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string text2 in array2)
				{
					text = text + text2 + "-";
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void grdVarList_PreviewMouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && !isDragging && e.OriginalSource is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && !(frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar) && (frameworkElement.TemplatedParent == null || !(frameworkElement.TemplatedParent is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar)) && ((MMScrollAreaBase)grdVarList).SelectedRowIndexes.Count == 1)
			{
				Record val = ((DataPresenterBase)((MMScrollAreaBase)grdVarList).DataGrid).Records[((MMScrollAreaBase)grdVarList).SelectedRowIndexes[0]];
				isDragging = true;
				System.Windows.DataObject data = new System.Windows.DataObject(((object)val).GetType(), val);
				DragDrop.DoDragDrop((DependencyObject)(object)val.DataPresenter, data, System.Windows.DragDropEffects.All);
			}
		}

		{
			isDragging = false;
		}
